apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::p.oneLiner: Collects shared + page asset files for a route
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::p.detail: Pulls `/_app` files as `sharedFiles` and the page's own files as `pageFiles` from the build manifest, plus a deduped `allFiles` union. Third arg (AMP mode) forces `pageFiles` empty since AMP pages ship no page JS.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::q.oneLiner: Renders legacy noModule polyfill script tags
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::q.detail: Maps `buildManifest.polyfillFiles` (only `.js`, excluding `.module.js`) to `<script noModule>` elements prefixed with assetPrefix and suffixed with the asset query string. `defer` is on unless optimized loading is disabled; nonce and crossOrigin fall back from props to config.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::r.oneLiner: Merges AMP inline styles into one <style amp-custom>
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::r.detail: Walks `styles.props.children` (one level of nesting), pulls each child's `dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html`, concatenates, and strips sourceMappingURL/sourceURL comments. If `styles` is a bare array with no `props`, the collected list stays empty and an empty style tag is emitted.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::s.oneLiner: Renders script tags for dynamic import chunks
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::s.detail: Emits a `<script>` per entry in `dynamicImports`, skipping non-`.js` files and anything already in `allFiles` (returns null for those, so the output array contains holes). async/defer flip on `disableOptimizedLoading` and dev mode.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::t.oneLiner: Renders main and low-priority script tags
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::t.detail: Concatenates the route's `.js` files with `buildManifest.lowPriorityFiles` `.js` entries and maps each to a `<script>` with assetPrefix, query string, nonce and crossOrigin. In dev, async is off so execution order is preserved.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::u.detail: Inner IIFE emits the Partytown config snippet plus `type="text/partytown"` worker scripts when `nextScriptWorkers` is set; it require()s `@builder.io/partytown/integration` and returns null on failure, warning only for non-MODULE_NOT_FOUND errors. Then appends `beforeInteractive` scripts that have a `src` — inline ones are handled elsewhere — and throws E82 for a worker script with neither src nor body.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.detail: Class component reading render state from `HtmlContext`; assembles CSS links, preloads, font preloads, trace metadata, AMP boilerplate and the FOUC-hiding dev style into a `<head>`. Sets `docComponentsRendered.Head = true` as a side effect, dedupes preload-style links ahead of other head tags, and warns-and-drops head tags that conflict with AMP.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.oneLiner: Builds preload+stylesheet links for CSS files
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.detail: Takes the file set from getDocumentFiles, appends dynamic-import CSS not already present, and emits a `rel=preload` link (skipped when `optimizeCss` is on) plus a `rel=stylesheet` link per file. `data-n-g` marks global/_app CSS and `data-n-p` marks page CSS that the client can remove on navigation; returns null when nothing was produced.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.oneLiner: Preload links for dynamic import JS chunks
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.detail: Maps `dynamicImports` to `<link rel=preload as=script>`, dropping non-`.js` entries via a trailing filter(Boolean). Reads assetPrefix and query string from context, nonce/crossOrigin from props.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.oneLiner: Preload links for main and beforeInteractive JS
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.detail: Emits preload links for every `beforeInteractive` script's raw `src` first, then for the route's `.js` files with assetPrefix and asset query applied. beforeInteractive srcs are used as-is — no prefixing or encoding.

Filters `scriptLoader.beforeInteractive` to entries with no `src` but with inline content, normalizing `children` (string or joined array) or `dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html` into the body. Tags carry `data-nscript="beforeInteractive"`; key falls back to array index when the script has no `id`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.oneLiner: Delegates to the dynamic-chunk script builder
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.detail: Calls `s(this.context, this.props, files)`. Exists so a custom Document subclass can override the dynamic script output.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.oneLiner: Delegates to the pre-Next script builder
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.detail: Calls `u(this.context, this.props)` to render Partytown worker and beforeInteractive src scripts. Override point for custom Document subclasses.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.oneLiner: Emits <script> tags for the page's build files
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.detail: Delegates to module-level helper `t(context, props, files)` where `files` is the computed script manifest. Pure render helper on the Head component; returns JSX, no side effects.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.oneLiner: Emits <script nomodule> tags for polyfill bundles
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.g.detail: Delegates to helper `q(context, props)`, which reads `buildManifest.polyfillFiles`. Returns JSX only.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.r.oneLiner: Renders the whole <head> for a pages-router document
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::v.r.detail: Pulls styles, AMP flags, buildManifest, nextFontManifest and loading flags off HtmlContext, splits user head elements into preload-style links vs everything else (tagging the latter `data-next-head`), then emits font preconnect/preload, trace metadata meta tags, CSS links, and JS preloads/scripts in an order that flips on `optimizeCss` and `disableOptimizedLoading`. apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.detail: Class component bound to HtmlContext; renders devFiles, the `__NEXT_DATA__` JSON script, and — only when `disableOptimizedLoading` is set — polyfills, pre-scripts, dynamic chunks and main scripts (otherwise Head already emitted them). Returns null in AMP mode and marks `docComponentsRendered.NextScript = true`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.g.detail: Delegates to helper `s(context, props, files)`. Render helper, JSX only.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.g.oneLiner: Emits <script> tags for the page's build files
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.g.detail: Same helper `t` as the Head version; duplicated so NextScript can emit scripts when optimized loading is off. Returns JSX.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.g.oneLiner: Emits <script nomodule> tags for polyfill bundles
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.g.detail: Same helper `q` as the Head version. Returns JSX.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.g.oneLiner: Serializes __NEXT_DATA__ to an HTML-safe JSON string
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.g.detail: JSON.stringify's the context's `__NEXT_DATA__` and runs it through `htmlEscapeJsonString` so `<`/`>`/U+2028 can't break out of the script tag. Warns once per page (deduped via the module-level Set `o`) when the payload exceeds `largePageDataBytes`, and converts a circular-structure TypeError into error E490 naming getInitialProps.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.r.oneLiner: Renders devFiles, __NEXT_DATA__, and optional runtime scripts
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::w.r.detail: Returns null in AMP mode; `unstable_runtimeJS === false` suppresses both devFiles and the data script. Script tags carry `nonce` and `crossOrigin` from props falling back to context; sets `docComponentsRendered.NextScript = true` as a side effect.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::x.oneLiner: Html component: renders <html> and harvests next/script children
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::x.detail: Before rendering, walks the children of <Head> and <body> looking for components flagged `__nextScript`, pushing beforeInteractive ones onto `scriptLoader.beforeInteractive` and the rest (default: afterInteractive) onto `__NEXT_DATA__.scriptLoader`. Mutates those context objects during render, sets `docComponentsRendered.Html = true`, and applies `lang` from props or the active locale plus the `amp` attribute.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::y.oneLiner: Main component: placeholder element for the page body
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::y.detail: Renders `<next-js-internal-body-render-target>`, a sentinel the server renderer later replaces with the actual app HTML. Sets `docComponentsRendered.Main = true`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::z.oneLiner: Default Document: Html > Head + body(Main, NextScript)
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::z.detail: The built-in `_app`-level document used when a project ships no custom `pages/_document`. Forwards `nonce` to Head and NextScript.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::z.g.oneLiner: Defers to the renderer's default getInitialProps
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::z.g.detail: Calls `ctx.defaultGetInitialProps(ctx)`, which runs the app render and returns collected `html`, `head` and `styles`. Custom documents that override this must call it too or styles go missing.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::z.r.oneLiner: Emits the standard document element tree
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::z.r.detail: Fixed structure: Html wrapping Head, then body containing Main and NextScript. No props beyond `nonce`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.i.oneLiner: Adds a route path to the trie
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.i.detail: Splits on `/`, drops empty segments, then recurses via `_insert`. Throws on malformed or conflicting dynamic segments.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.s.oneLiner: Flattens the trie to a sorted route list
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.s.detail: Thin wrapper calling `_smoosh('/')`. Returns route strings with original slug names restored.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c._.oneLiner: Recursive flatten: static, then slug, then catch-alls
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c._.detail: Sorts literal children alphabetically and visits them first, then `[]`, then `[...]`, then `[[...]]`, which is exactly Next's route-matching precedence. Throws E458 when a concrete route has the same specificity as a sibling optional catch-all (e.g. `/a` and `/a/[[...x]]`).

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c._.oneLiner: Recursive insert that parses and validates slug segments
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c._.detail: Strips brackets to get the slug name, detects optional (`[[...]]`) and rest (`[...]`) forms, and rejects `…`, extra brackets, leading dots, duplicate or non-word-only-differing slug names, catch-all not in final position, and mixing required with optional catch-all at one level. Mutates the node's slugName fields and the accumulator array `b` of slug names seen on this path.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.c.oneLiner: Copies given entries into a fresh Map
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.c.detail: Accepts an iterable/Map of entries or nothing. Copies, so the caller's map is not aliased.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.c.oneLiner: Wires diag log methods to the global diag logger
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.c.detail: Builds each level method as a proxy that no-ops when no logger is registered. setLogger(logger, {logLevel, suppressOverrideMessage}) wraps the logger by level and force-overwrites any existing one, warning on both old and new loggers unless suppressed; passing the DiagAPI itself is rejected and returns false.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.i.detail: Returns the cached instance or constructs one. Named `instance`, not `getInstance` like the other APIs in this chunk.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.g.detail: Returns the cached instance or constructs one.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.s.detail: Returns false if a provider is already registered or the API version is incompatible — it does not overwrite. Diag logs the reason.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.g.oneLiner: Returns registered MeterProvider or a no-op one
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.g.detail: Never returns undefined. A no-op result means setGlobalMeterProvider was never called or failed silently.
Args are (name, version, options). Resolves the provider per call, so a Meter obtained before SDK init comes from the no-op provider and stays no-op.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::h.d.detail: Subsequent getMeter calls fall back to no-op. Mainly for tests.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.oneLiner: PropagationAPI: global context propagator + baggage helpers
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.detail: Singleton that delegates inject/extract/fields to the registered TextMapPropagator, defaulting to `k` (a no-op propagator) when none is set. Also re-exports the baggage create/get/set/delete functions as instance methods.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.c.oneLiner: Copies baggage helper functions onto the instance
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.c.detail: Pure aliasing of module-level functions — no state. Lets callers do `propagation.setBaggage(ctx, b)` off the single API object.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.g.detail: Returns the cached instance or constructs one.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.s.detail: Returns false if one is already registered or versions mismatch; no overwrite. Key `j` is the propagation API registry key.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.i.oneLiner: Writes context into a carrier (e.g. HTTP headers)
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.i.detail: Setter defaults to defaultTextMapSetter, which does carrier[key]=value. Silently a no-op if no propagator is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.e.oneLiner: Reads context out of a carrier, returns new Context
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.e.detail: Getter defaults to defaultTextMapGetter. With no registered propagator returns the input context unchanged — a common cause of broken trace linking.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.f.oneLiner: Lists carrier keys the propagator writes
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.f.detail: Used to clear stale headers before inject. Empty array when no propagator is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l.d.detail: inject/extract revert to no-op. Mainly for tests.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l._.oneLiner: Registered propagator, else the no-op fallback
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::l._.detail: Private resolver called on every inject/extract/fields. Fallback `k` accepts calls and does nothing.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.oneLiner: TraceAPI: global tracer provider + span/context helpers
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.detail: Always registers its own ProxyTracerProvider globally, then points that proxy at the real SDK provider — so Tracers obtained before SDK init start emitting once the delegate is set. Also aliases the span-context helpers (getSpan, setSpan, wrapSpanContext, etc.).

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.c.oneLiner: Creates the ProxyTracerProvider; aliases span helpers
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.c.detail: The proxy is the indirection that makes early getTracer calls work. Helpers are plain function references, no state.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.g.detail: Returns the cached instance or constructs one.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.s.oneLiner: Registers the proxy, then delegates it to the real provider
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.s.detail: Registers `this._proxyTracerProvider` (not the argument) under key `i`; only on success does it call setDelegate(a). Returns false if a provider was already registered, leaving the delegate unset.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.g.oneLiner: Returns registered provider, else the local proxy
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.g.detail: After a successful setGlobalTracerProvider both are the same object. Before init, the proxy hands out no-op tracers that upgrade later.
Safe to call at module load — the returned Tracer routes through the proxy and starts recording once a delegate is set.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.d.oneLiner: Unregisters the provider and resets the proxy
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::j.d.detail: Replaces `_proxyTracerProvider` with a fresh one, so Tracers held from before disable() keep the old proxy and stay dead. Mainly for tests.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.g.oneLiner: Shallow copy of one entry, or undefined
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.g.detail: Returns `Object.assign({}, entry)` so callers can't mutate stored entries. Shallow only — nested metadata objects stay shared.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.g.oneLiner: All entries as fresh array of [key, entry] pairs
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.g.detail: New outer array and new pair arrays each call, but the entry objects are the live stored references, unlike `getEntry`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.s.oneLiner: Returns new Baggage with key set to entry
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.s.detail: Clones the Map, sets the key, returns the clone. O(n) per call — building baggage in a loop is quadratic.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.r.oneLiner: Returns new Baggage without the given key
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.r.detail: Clones the Map and deletes the key. Missing key is a no-op that still allocates a new instance.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.r.oneLiner: Returns new Baggage minus all listed keys
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.r.detail: One clone for the whole variadic list, then deletes each key. Cheaper than chaining `removeEntry`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::c.c.detail: New instance with no entries. Original untouched.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.a.detail: Ignores whatever context a caller set via `with`. Any parent-span lookup against it comes back empty.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.w.oneLiner: Calls fn with thisArg and args, discards the context
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.w.detail: Signature `(context, fn, thisArg, ...args)`; returns fn's return value. The context argument is dropped entirely.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.b.detail: No context is captured, so a bound callback run later sees ROOT_CONTEXT.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.e.detail: Present to satisfy the ContextManager interface.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.d.detail: Present to satisfy the ContextManager interface.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.c.detail: Assigns the four args to `_provider`, `name`, `version`, `options`. No delegate resolution happens here — that is deferred to `_getTracer`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.d.oneLiner: Logs at debug level via the global diag logger
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.d.detail: Forwards varargs to `f("debug", namespace, args)`. Silently drops the call if no global logger is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.e.oneLiner: Logs at error level via the global diag logger
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.e.detail: Forwards varargs to `f("error", namespace, args)`. Silently drops the call if no global logger is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.i.oneLiner: Logs at info level via the global diag logger
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.i.detail: Forwards varargs to `f("info", namespace, args)`. Silently drops the call if no global logger is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.w.oneLiner: Logs at warn level via the global diag logger
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.w.detail: Forwards varargs to `f("warn", namespace, args)`. Silently drops the call if no global logger is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.v.oneLiner: Logs at verbose level via the global diag logger
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.v.detail: Forwards varargs to `f("verbose", namespace, args)`. Silently drops the call if no global logger is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.g.oneLiner: Noop provider: always hands back a NoopTracer
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.g.detail: Ignores name, version, and options and returns a fresh NoopTracer every call. This is the no-op TracerProvider used before SDK registration.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.s.oneLiner: Delegates startSpan to the resolved tracer
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.s.detail: Takes span name, options, context and returns the delegate's Span. Returns a non-recording span while the delegate is still noop.
Uses Reflect.apply with `arguments` so the overloads (name, [options], [context], fn) pass through untouched. Returns whatever the callback returns.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.oneLiner: Resolves and caches the real tracer, else noop
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.detail: Asks the provider for a delegate tracer; caches it permanently on first success. On failure returns the noop tracer without caching, so it retries next call.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.g.oneLiner: Real tracer if delegate set, otherwise a ProxyTracer
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.g.detail: Returns the delegate's tracer when available; otherwise a ProxyTracer bound to this provider and the given name/version/options.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.g.oneLiner: Current delegate provider, or the noop provider
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.g.detail: Returns `_delegate` if set, else the shared NoopTracerProvider. Never returns undefined.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.s.oneLiner: Installs the real provider; existing proxies pick it up
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.s.detail: Sets `_delegate`. ProxyTracers created earlier resolve to it on their next span call and cache it from then on.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.g.oneLiner: Delegate's tracer, or undefined if no delegate
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::f.g.detail: Optional-chains through `_delegate.getTracer`. Undefined is the signal callers use to fall back to proxy/noop.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.oneLiner: setSpan: returns context with span attached
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.detail: Returns a new context from `context.setValue(SPAN_KEY, span)`. Contexts are immutable — the original is unchanged, use the return value.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.s.oneLiner: Clone with key set as the most-recent entry
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.s.detail: Deletes any existing key first so the key moves to the end of the Map, which is the front on serialize. Original instance untouched.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.u.detail: Returns a new TraceState; no error if the key was absent.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.g.oneLiner: Value for a key, or undefined
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.g.detail: Plain Map lookup, no validation or trimming.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.s.oneLiner: Renders entries as comma-joined `k=v` header text
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e.s.detail: Uses `_keys` order, so the most recently set key comes first per W3C spec. No spaces, no re-validation.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.oneLiner: Parses tracestate header, dropping invalid entries
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.detail: Bails entirely if input exceeds 512 chars; splits on commas in reverse, keeps only entries passing validateKey/validateValue, then truncates to the first 32 by header order. Splits on the first `=` so values may contain `=`.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.oneLiner: Keys in header order (most recent first)
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.detail: Reverses the Map's insertion order, since internal storage is reversed. Used only by serialize.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.oneLiner: Shallow copy of the state Map into a new TraceState
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::e._.detail: Copies entries into a fresh Map, preserving order. Backs the immutability of set/unset.

apps/web/.next/server/webpack-runtime.js.oneLiner: webpack require: loads module by id, caches exports
apps/web/.next/server/webpack-runtime.js.detail: Returns cached `b[d].exports` if present, else creates the cache entry, runs the factory `a[d](module, module.exports, c)`, and returns exports. The `g` flag deletes the cache entry if the factory throws, so a failed module isn't left half-initialized and can be retried.

apps/web/.next/server/webpack-runtime.js.oneLiner: chunk-loaded callback: registers modules, runs runtime
apps/web/.next/server/webpack-runtime.js.detail: Takes a chunk `{modules, ids, runtime}`, copies own-property modules into the registry `c.m`, invokes `runtime(c)` if present, then marks each id in `a` as 1 (loaded). Shadows the outer module cache name `b` inside its own body — the `b` in `c` is the cache, this `b` is the chunk parameter.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::c.oneLiner: Sets key/data/size, nulls both link pointers
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::c.detail: Takes (key, data, size) and stores them; prev and next start null until the node is spliced into a list.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::d.detail: No arguments. Pointers are wired up by the cache constructor.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Builds empty cache with maxSize, sizer, evict callback
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Args are (maxSize, calculateSize, onEvict); the latter two are optional and default to size 1 / no-op at call sites. Allocates head and tail sentinels and links them to each other.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Splices a node in right after the head sentinel
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Marks the node as most-recently-used. Assumes the node is currently detached; adding an already-linked node corrupts the list.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Unlinks a node from its neighbors
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Rewires prev.next and next.prev around it. Leaves the node's own pointers stale, which is why callers immediately re-add or drop it.
removeNode then addToHead. Called on every hit in get and on overwrite in set.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Unlinks and returns the least-recently-used node
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Reads tail.prev, detaches it, returns it. On an empty list this returns the head sentinel, so callers must guard on cache.size — set does.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Inserts or updates a key, then evicts until under maxSize
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Computes size via calculateSize (default 1); throws E789 if size <= 0 and returns false with a console.warn if a single item exceeds maxSize. Updates adjust totalSize by the delta; eviction pops from the tail, deletes from the Map, and fires onEvict per victim. Returns true on success.
Delegates to Map.has. Does not promote the entry, so a has-then-get pair still needs the get to reorder.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Returns data for a key and promotes it to head
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Miss returns undefined, which is indistinguishable from a stored undefined value — use has to disambiguate. Mutates recency order as a side effect.
Generator walking head.next to the tail sentinel. Removing entries mid-iteration leaves the cursor on a detached node, so the walk can end early or stray.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Deletes a key and reclaims its size
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Unlinks the node, drops the Map entry, subtracts its size from totalSize. No-op for a missing key; does not fire onEvict.
Map.size, i.e. an entry count. Not the byte/weight total.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Getter: summed size of cached entries
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: The value compared against maxSize during eviction. Tracked incrementally, never recomputed.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.oneLiner: Renders this.props.Component with pageProps spread in
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.detail: Pulls Component and pageProps off props and returns jsx(Component, {...pageProps}). No wrappers, providers, or layout.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::p.oneLiner: Wraps one value in a closed single-chunk ReadableStream
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::p.detail: Enqueues `a` in `start` then closes immediately. No backpressure handling; the value is buffered whether or not anyone reads.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::q.oneLiner: Drains a byte stream into one Buffer
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::q.detail: Reads to completion via a reader, collects chunks, returns `Buffer.concat`. Buffers everything in memory and never releases the lock, so the stream is consumed exclusively.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::r.oneLiner: Decodes a byte stream to a string, abortable
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::r.detail: Streaming UTF-8 decode with `fatal:true`, so invalid bytes throw. If `b.aborted` flips mid-iteration it returns the partial string without the final flush decode.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::s.oneLiner: Coalesces queued chunks into one Uint8Array per tick
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::s.detail: Buffers incoming chunks and, on `scheduleImmediate`, concatenates and enqueues them as a single chunk; `flush` waits on the pending DetachedPromise. The enqueue is wrapped in an empty `catch`, so a closed/errored controller silently drops the batch.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::t.oneLiner: Inserts the build-id comment into the first HTML chunk
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::t.detail: Only acts when `a` (isBuildTimePrerendering) is true; decodes chunk one, calls `insertBuildIdComment(html, buildId)`, re-encodes, passes everything after through untouched. Assumes chunk one is valid UTF-8 and contains the insertion point.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::u.detail: Wraps the render in an `AppRenderSpan.renderToReadableStream` tracer span. Pure passthrough otherwise — returns React's stream.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::v.oneLiner: Swaps the metadata icon marker for server-inserted metadata
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::v.detail: Finds `META.ICON_MARK` in a chunk, strips the marker (accounting for a self-closing `/`), and on chunk 0 only strips it if it precedes `</head>`, otherwise splices in `await getServerInsertedMetadata()`. Runs once — after the first hit every later chunk is passed through.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::w.oneLiner: Injects server-inserted HTML before </head>, then per chunk
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::w.detail: On the first chunk it splices the awaited HTML before `</head>` if present; from then on it prepends the awaited HTML ahead of each chunk, and `flush` appends a final call if any chunk was seen. `getServerInsertedHTML` is awaited on every chunk, so it must be cheap and idempotent.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::x.oneLiner: Merges an inlined data stream into the HTML output
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::x.detail: Pumps `a` (the inlined flight-data stream) into the same controller, either immediately or, when `b` is set, not until the first HTML chunk arrives; `flush` waits for the pump to finish. Yields via `atLeastOneTask` to interleave with HTML, and forwards read errors to `controller.error`.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::z.oneLiner: CommonJS interop wrapper for a module namespace
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::z.detail: Returns the module untouched if `__esModule`, else wraps it as `{default: a}`. Standard SWC/Babel `_interop_require_default` helper.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::A.oneLiner: Builds the Pages Router request handler for one page
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::A.detail: Takes the page's userland module, config, routeModule and data-fetching exports; returns an async (req, res, ctx) handler that prepares the request, computes a cache key, runs render through the response cache, and handles fallbacks, 404/500/_error, i18n, AMP, draft mode, on-demand revalidation and OTel spans. Side effects: writes status/headers/body on res, sets `x-nextjs-cache`, calls ctx.waitUntil, reports errors via routeModule.onRequestError; throws NoFallbackError when a dynamic route has `fallback: false` and no prerender.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::B.oneLiner: Builds the full app-render stream pipeline
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::B.detail: Awaits `allReady` for static generation, then pipes React's stream through chunk coalescing, build-id insert, metadata insert, an optional suffix injector, inlined data, root-layout validation, closing-tag handling, and server-inserted HTML. The suffix is truncated at the closing-tags marker and emitted once, either after the first chunk or in flush.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::C.oneLiner: Render pipeline that leaves the document open
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::C.detail: Coalesces chunks, drops chunks that are only closing `</body>`/`</html>` and strips those tags from mixed chunks, then applies server-inserted HTML and metadata. Used where more content will be appended, so nothing closes the document.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::D.oneLiner: Prerender pipeline: build id, inserts, data, closing tags
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::D.detail: Coalesce → build-id comment → server-inserted HTML → metadata → inlined data (undelayed) → closing-tag normalization. Produces a complete, self-closing HTML document.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::E.oneLiner: Resume/continue pipeline without the build-id step
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::E.detail: Same shape as `D` minus the build-id insert, and honors `delayDataUntilFirstHtmlChunk` when merging the inlined data stream. Used for continuing an already-started render.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::F.oneLiner: Single-chunk stream of the closing-tags constant
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::F.detail: Feeds the shared closing-tag byte sequence `y` through the single-value stream helper. Handy as a tail stream when a document must be closed manually.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::c.oneLiner: Index of first occurrence of byte subarray b in a
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::c.detail: Naive O(n·m) scan; returns 0 for empty needle, -1 if absent or needle longer than haystack. Byte-wise equality only.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::d.detail: Length check then element-wise compare, returns boolean. Not constant-time — do not use for comparing secrets.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.oneLiner: Returns a with the first occurrence of b removed
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::e.detail: Uses subarray (zero-copy view) when b is a prefix, otherwise allocates a new Uint8Array and copies both sides. Returns `a` unchanged if b is absent; the prefix case shares the original buffer.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::f.oneLiner: Promise resolving on the next setImmediate
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::f.detail: Same effect as `e` but calls `setImmediate` directly. Awaiting it guarantees at least one task boundary.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.oneLiner: Builds a URL, swapping a placeholder host for localhost
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.detail: Replaces matches of regex `h` in both the URL and base string before `new URL`, so internal placeholder hosts parse. Throws the usual TypeError on an invalid relative URL with no base.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.oneLiner: NextURL: URL plus locale, basePath, buildId, trailingSlash
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.detail: Wraps a native URL in a symbol-keyed state bag and re-parses Next.js path segments on construction and on `href` assignment. `href`/`toString` re-serialize from the parsed parts, so a rewritten locale or basePath is reflected; `clone()` re-parses from the string with the same options.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.oneLiner: Renders the status code, message, and inline error styles
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.detail: Picks message as `props.title` → status map lookup → "An unexpected error has occurred", and skips the `<h1>` entirely when there is no status code. Injects a stylesheet through `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; `withDarkMode` defaults true and adds the `prefers-color-scheme` block.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.oneLiner: Validates URL, sets duplex, builds cookies and NextURL
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.detail: Resolves the URL from a string or a Request-like `url`, calls `validateURL`, sets `duplex:"half"` for body requests, and forwards to the Request super constructor. Then builds `NextURL` from outgoing node headers plus `options.nextConfig` and stores state under the private symbol.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.oneLiner: Dumps NextRequest fields as plain object for inspect
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.detail: Edge runtime calls this instead of walking the Request; returns cookies, nextUrl, url plus standard fetch Request props with headers flattened via Object.fromEntries. Debug/logging only, no side effects.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.oneLiner: RequestCookies from the internal state bag
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.detail: Reads `this[h].cookies`, the parsed cookie jar built when the NextRequest was constructed. Mutating it does not rewrite the Cookie header on an outgoing fetch.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.oneLiner: NextURL for this request (locale, basePath, buildId parsed)
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.detail: Returns the `k` NextURL instance stored in the internal state symbol. Mutations are live — middleware rewrites work by assigning to nextUrl.pathname.
Removed Next.js 12 middleware API (`request.page.name`/`params`). Tombstone getter so upgrades fail loudly instead of reading undefined.
Removed built-in user-agent parsing. Use the exported `userAgent(request)` helper from `next/server` instead.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.oneLiner: Request URL string from internal state
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::i.detail: Overrides `Request.prototype.url` with the normalized value captured at construction. May differ from the raw incoming URL after locale/basePath normalization.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::g.oneLiner: True if UA is an HTML-limited bot
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::g.detail: Regex test against HTML_LIMITED_BOT_UA_RE — crawlers that read HTML but do not run JS or stream. Used to force full non-streamed HTML.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::h.oneLiner: True if UA is any known bot
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::h.detail: OR of the module-level `e` regex (JS-capable/DOM bots) and `g`. Purely UA-string based, so trivially spoofable — never use for auth.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.oneLiner: Parses input into NextURL, accepting (url, base?, options?)
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.detail: Detects whether the second arg is a base (string or object with pathname) or the options object, stores `{url, options, basePath}` and calls analyze(). Options carry nextConfig, i18nProvider, headers, forceLocale.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.oneLiner: Splits pathname into basePath, buildId, locale, trailingSlash
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.detail: Runs getNextPathnameInfo, resolves domainLocale from the i18nProvider or nextConfig.i18n.domains using the Host header, then strips those segments from `url.pathname` and stores them. Mutates internal state; called on construct and on `href` set.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.oneLiner: Reassembles pathname from basePath, buildId, locale
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.detail: Delegates to formatNextPathnameInfo; omits the default locale when `options.forceLocale` is set. Pure — used by the `href` getter.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.oneLiner: Returns the query string including leading '?'
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.detail: Passthrough to the underlying URL's `search`. Empty string when there is no query.

apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.oneLiner: Default locale from domain match or i18n config
apps/web/.next/server/pages/_error.js::k.detail: Resolved during analyze(); domainLocale.defaultLocale wins over nextConfig.i18n.defaultLocale. Read-only.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Flattens the trie to a sorted route list
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Thin wrapper calling `_smoosh('/')`. Returns route strings with original slug names restored.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Sizes a Bloom filter from item count + error rate
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Takes expected item count and target false-positive rate (default 1e-4), computes numBits = -n·ln(p)/ln(2)² and numHashes = (numBits/n)·ln2, allocates a plain Array of 0s. Uses one JS number per bit, not a packed bitset, so memory is ~8 bytes per bit.

apps/web/next.config.ts::rewrites.oneLiner: Proxies /api/* to the backend origin in `api`
apps/web/next.config.ts::rewrites.detail: Next.js server-side rewrite: browser keeps the /api/... URL while Next fetches from `${api}/api/...`, so no CORS and no client-visible redirect. `api` is resolved when the config loads (build/server start), so an unset env var silently produces `undefined/api/...` and a trailing slash in it produces a double slash.

apps/web/app/planner/page.tsx::Planner.oneLiner: Client page: week grid of scheduled blocks + sidebar
apps/web/app/planner/page.tsx::Planner.detail: Fetches the plan from `api.plan()` on mount, renders a VISIBLE_DAYS-wide `<Grid>` with an aside for moved/unmet/legend panels, wrapped in `<Shell onPlanChange={load}>` so child mutations trigger a refetch. State is plan/error/selected/weekOffset; a fetch failure sets `error` but leaves the previous `plan` rendered.

apps/web/app/planner/page.tsx::Panel.oneLiner: Bordered card with uppercase heading and children
apps/web/app/planner/page.tsx::Panel.detail: Pure presentational wrapper: takes title and children, renders a rounded/shadowed surface with the title as a small uppercase h2. No state, no side effects.

apps/web/app/components/Reveal.tsx::Reve.oneLiner: Fades child content in when it scrolls into view
apps/web/app/components/Reveal.tsx::Reve.detail: Renders children in a chosen tag (div/section/li/header) starting at opacity 0 and translateY(14px), then transitions to visible once an IntersectionObserver fires (threshold 0.05, bottom margin -12%); delay ms staggers the transition. Honors prefers-reduced-motion by showing immediately; the observer disconnects after the first intersection, so it never re-hides, and the ref is cast to any since the element type varies by tag.

apps/web/app/components/Reveal.tsx::useS.oneLiner: Returns 0..1 scroll position through a tall element
apps/web/app/components/Reveal.tsx::useS.detail: Takes a ref to an element taller than the viewport and returns -rect.top / (height - innerHeight) clamped to 0..1, recomputed on every animation frame and only committed when it moves more than 0.002. Returns 0 when the element is not taller than the viewport; the rAF loop runs continuously while mounted rather than on scroll events, and re-subscribes if the ref identity changes.

apps/web/app/components/StabilityDemo.ts.oneLiner: Shape of a calendar block in the demo grid
apps/web/app/components/StabilityDemo.ts.detail: Fields: id, title, day (column index), from/to (start hour before and after the re-plan), span (height in hour rows), tier 1-4 (priority driving color). Unused in the shown code — BLOCKS is typed elsewhere; from === to means the block never moves.
Below 0.5 returns 4t³, above returns 1 - (2-2t)³/2; slow at both ends, fast in the middle. Does not clamp — feed it a pre-clamped value.

apps/web/app/components/StabilityDemo.ts.oneLiner: Scroll-scrubbed week grid where 2 of N blocks move
apps/web/app/components/StabilityDemo.ts.detail: 280vh track with a sticky viewport; useScrollProgress(track) gives 0-1, mapped to meetingIn (fade/scale of the Wed 10:00-13:00 "Offsite" over progress 0.24-0.44) and eased shift (block interpolation from block.from to block.to over 0.48-0.76). Moving blocks get a dashed left border and a glow ring that peaks at shift 0.5; movedCount is hardcoded to 2 once shift > 0.5, and the Offsite block is hardcoded to dayIndex 2, so both break if BLOCKS changes.

apps/web/app/page.tsx::Landing.oneLiner: Root page component: full marketing landing page
apps/web/app/page.tsx::Landing.detail: Renders Nav, hero header, metrics strip, StabilityDemo section, feature grid, and model section as static JSX; no props, no state. Maps over module-level METRICS and AGENTS arrays, wrapping each item in Reveal with a staggered delay (i * 70 / i * 60) for scroll-in animation.

apps/web/app/page.tsx::Nav.oneLiner: Sticky top nav bar with logo and two links
apps/web/app/page.tsx::Nav.detail: Static markup: Mark logo + wordmark linking to /, an in-page anchor to #how (hidden below sm), and a /login button. Uses sticky top-0 z-40 with backdrop blur, so a higher z-index elsewhere will overlap it.

apps/web/app/page.tsx::Mark.detail: Circle outline plus clock hands, colored from CSS vars --color-fg and --color-accent so it follows the theme. aria-hidden — decorative only, so any link containing it needs its own accessible text.

apps/web/app/login/page.tsx::Login.oneLiner: Login page with a button that routes to /planner
apps/web/app/login/page.tsx::Login.detail: Client component; `enter()` sets `pending` true and calls `router.push("/planner")` — no auth, no credentials, purely navigational since the app assumes a local instance behind an SSO proxy. `pending` never resets, so the button stays disabled showing "Opening…" after click; the rest is static markup (Wave background, logo Link, SSO copy, footer).

apps/web/.next/server/app/login/page.js:.oneLiner: Renders a blank blurred canvas used as backdrop glow
apps/web/.next/server/app/login/page.js:.detail: Takes className, appends it to a full-size pointer-events-none canvas with a 28px blur + saturate filter, and holds a ref that nothing in this component reads. Marked aria-hidden; the ref is presumably grabbed by a parent or animation hook elsewhere — as compiled here it never paints, so the canvas is transparent.

apps/web/.next/server/app/login/page.js:.oneLiner: Next.js server request handler for the /login route
apps/web/.next/server/app/login/page.js:.detail: Build output, not source. Prepares the route module for the incoming req/res, resolves buildId, query, params, manifests and the prerender/PPR config, then renders the app page via LoaderTree and returns a cached entry ({kind: APP_PAGE, html, rscData, postponed, status, segmentData} plus cacheControl) or writes 400/404 directly. Side effects: sets Vary and NEXT_CACHE_TAGS_HEADER, installs the server-action/client-reference manifest singleton, opens tracing spans, handles draft mode, bot detection, on-demand revalidation and fallback modes; throws E132 if a static page turns dynamic at runtime.

apps/web/.next/server/app/login/page.js:.oneLiner: Login page: card explaining local-only auth, button to /planner
apps/web/.next/server/app/login/page.js:.detail: Client component. Renders the Wave backdrop, Horolog logo link, copy saying there is nothing to sign in to, an SSO-proxy note, and a button that sets a local loading flag then router.push('/planner'). No credentials, no network call — the flag only disables the button and swaps the label to 'Opening…', and never resets, so a failed navigation leaves it stuck disabled.

apps/web/.next/server/app/page.js::o.detail: No props. Composes nav `p`, hero header with `k.Wave` background canvas, stat grid from array `l`, `j.StabilityDemo` under `#how`, feature grid from array `m` (each icon via `h`), and a bring-your-own-model section; wraps blocks in `i.Reveal` with staggered `delay` in ms. Pure layout — copy and Tailwind classes only, no state or data fetching.

apps/web/.next/server/app/page.js::p.oneLiner: Sticky top nav bar with logo and two links
apps/web/.next/server/app/page.js::p.detail: No props. `sticky top-0 z-40` with translucent blurred bg; logo mark from `q`, an anchor to `#how` hidden below `sm`, and a `next/link` to `/login`. Static — no active-route highlighting or mobile menu.

apps/web/.next/server/app/page.js::q.detail: No props, fixed size. Circle stroked with `var(--color-fg)` plus hands path in `var(--color-accent)`, so it follows theme CSS variables rather than `currentColor`. aria-hidden.

apps/web/.next/server/app/page.js::g.oneLiner: Scroll-progress hook, stubbed to always return 0
apps/web/.next/server/app/page.js::g.detail: Takes a ref, holds `useState(0)` and returns the value unchanged. The setter is unused and no scroll listener exists, so every consumer (e.g. `k`) sees progress 0 and animations never advance.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.c.oneLiner: Empty; MetricsAPI keeps no instance state
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.c.detail: Exists only to be private-by-convention. All state is in the global registry.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::q.c.detail: Takes a page path, sets code "ENOENT", name "PageNotFoundError", message "Cannot find module for page: <page>". ENOENT makes callers treat a missing page bundle like a missing file, so fs-style error handling catches it.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::r.c.oneLiner: Sets message from page and file arguments
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::r.c.detail: Args are page path and file path; concatenated into "Failed to load static file for page: <page> <file>". Calls super() with no message, then overwrites this.message.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::s.c.oneLiner: Sets ENOENT code and fixed middleware message
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::s.c.detail: No inputs. Assigns code and message after super().

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.g.oneLiner: Returns the lazily created singleton instance
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.g.detail: Caches on the static _instance field. Constructor is public, so a second instance is possible but would still read the same global registry.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.s.oneLiner: Registers a context manager in the OTel globals
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.s.detail: Takes a ContextManager, registers it under the context key with the DiagAPI logger. Returns false and logs a warning if one is already registered — first writer wins.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.a.detail: Forwards to the registered manager. With the noop fallback this is always ROOT_CONTEXT.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.w.oneLiner: Runs a callback with a given Context active
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.w.detail: Args: context, fn, thisArg, then fn's arguments; returns fn's return value. Async continuation only propagates if a real (e.g. AsyncLocalStorage) manager is registered.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.b.oneLiner: Binds a Context to a target for later invocation
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.b.detail: Args are context and a target (function or emitter); returns the bound target. The noop manager returns the target unchanged.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i._.oneLiner: Reads the global manager or the noop fallback
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i._.detail: Looks up the context key in the OTel global registry each call, so registration order does not matter. Internal.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.d.oneLiner: Disables and unregisters the context manager
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/611.js::i.d.detail: Calls disable() on the current manager then removes it from globals, reverting to noop. Subsequent spans lose context propagation.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: JSON fetch wrapper that throws on non-2xx
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: Calls fetch(url, init) with content-type: application/json merged ahead of caller headers, so a caller-supplied content-type wins. On !ok it throws Error with the JSON body's `detail` field, falling back to `"<status> <statusText>"` if the body isn't JSON; returns undefined on 204, otherwise the parsed JSON.
Date.parse(b) - Date.parse(a) in whole minutes, rounded. Unparseable input yields NaN silently.
Splits minutes into hours and remainder; drops the minute part when zero and the hour part when under 60. 0 renders as 0m.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: Command-palette modal for capturing an intent
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: Renders null unless open; on submit sends the trimmed text to g.capture, then calls onCaptured and onClose, showing the thrown message inline on failure. Escape or backdrop click closes; the input ref is created but never focused, so the field is not autofocused.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: Renders the icon for a block kind
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: Looks up the SVG path set in map l by kind and wraps it in a 20x20 stroked svg sized by the size prop (default 15). Decorative only: aria-hidden, no fallback if kind is missing from l.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: ISO timestamp to YYYY-MM-DD day key
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: First 10 characters of the string. Used to bucket blocks into day columns, so it keys by the timestamp's own offset, not local time.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: Time to pixel offset in the day column
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: Converts a timestamp to minutes since local midnight, subtracts 420 (7am, the grid's first row), and scales at 58px per hour. Anything before 7am or after 9pm lands outside the 812px column.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: Formats a timestamp as local clock time
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: toLocaleTimeString with numeric hour and 2-digit minute, using the browser locale. Locale-dependent output differs between server and client render.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: Week grid: hour rows, busy plus scheduled blocks
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: Draws a 14-row 7am-9pm gutter and one column per day, filtering blocks and busy by day key; busy sits at z-0 as static divs, scheduled blocks at z-10 as buttons colored by priority with a dashed left border when moved_from differs from start. Clicking a block toggles selection via onSelect (null to deselect), keyed by intent_id:occurrence:chunk; heights floor at 22px (16px for busy) and the time line only shows above 38px.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: Planner page root: fetches plan, renders week
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: Holds plan, error, modal open, selected block, and week offset; the g.plan fetch callback is wired only to the capture modal's onCaptured, so nothing in this code loads a plan on mount. Week arrows shift the displayed 7 days by offset but do not refetch, and total scheduled minutes plus moved-block count are memoized from the current plan.
Bordered surface panel rendering the title as a small uppercase h2 above children. Layout only, no state.

apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.oneLiner: Next.js compiled request handler for the /planner App Router page
apps/web/.next/server/app/planner/page.j.detail: Takes (req, res, ctx) and prepares route metadata — buildId, query, params, prerender manifest, client reference manifest — then renders the App Router page through the route module and returns a cache entry {value:{kind:APP_PAGE, html, rscData, postponed, segmentData}, cacheControl}. Handles bot detection, RSC/prefetch header parsing, PPR resumption from postponed state, draft mode, on-demand revalidation, and fallback modes; sets Vary and cache-tag headers, throws E132 if a static page goes dynamic at runtime.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::d.oneLiner: True when the value's length equals constant c
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::d.detail: Length equality test against a module-level constant, used to validate that a server-reference id is the expected hashed length. Purely a shape check — no format or content validation.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.oneLiner: True if URL is same-origin and under basePath
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.detail: `isLocalURL`: relative URLs pass immediately; absolute ones must resolve to the current origin and carry the configured basePath. Any parse failure returns false, and it depends on `window.location`, so it's browser-only.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::q.c.detail: Takes a page path, sets code "ENOENT", name "PageNotFoundError", message "Cannot find module for page: <page>". ENOENT makes callers treat a missing page bundle like a missing file, so fs-style error handling catches it.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::r.c.oneLiner: Sets message from page and file arguments
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::r.c.detail: Args are page path and file path; concatenated into "Failed to load static file for page: <page> <file>". Calls super() with no message, then overwrites this.message.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::s.c.oneLiner: Sets ENOENT code and fixed middleware message
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::s.c.detail: No inputs. Assigns code and message after super().

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::g.oneLiner: Builds a prefetch cache key from URL, search flag, nextUrl
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::g.detail: Key is pathname, optionally plus search, optionally prefixed with `${nextUrl}%`. The `%` prefix marks interception-scoped entries — code elsewhere tests `key.includes('%')` to detect them.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::h.detail: `formatWithValidation` — in the production build the dev-only URL-object shape check is compiled out, leaving a direct call to `f`. Safe to treat as an alias.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::i.oneLiner: Gets or creates a prefetch cache entry for a URL
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::i.detail: Looks up interception-scoped then plain keys (and, when aliasing is allowed, any same-pathname entry) and refreshes status; misses fall through to k() to kick off a fetch. Upgrading an existing non-FULL entry to FULL triggers a background re-prefetch unless the resolved flightData already contains root-render seed data; TEMPORARY entries get their kind promoted in place.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::j.detail: Private fields: f = max concurrent, g = running count, h = pending array of {promiseFn, task}, i = the drain method `k`. No cancellation, no priority beyond `bump`, no error aggregation — a rejected task only rejects its own promise.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::k.oneLiner: Runs next queued task if under the concurrency limit
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::k.detail: Private drain method bound as `this[i]`; shifts one entry off the queue and invokes its task when running < limit, or unconditionally when the force flag is true. Called after every enqueue and after every task settles.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::l.oneLiner: Applies server flight data to router tree and cache
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::l.detail: Reducer body for server patches: for each flight-data entry it patches the router state tree, builds a new CacheNode — seeding RSC payloads and `loading` from seedData on a root render, otherwise cloning the existing cache and filling only loading boundaries — and collects scrollable segment paths. Returns false immediately when flight data is a string (MPA navigation) or when no patch applied; otherwise writes patchedTree/cache/canonicalUrl/hashFragment/scrollableSegments onto the mutable object and returns handleMutable's result.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::o.oneLiner: Registers a link element in the prefetch instance map
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::o.detail: If the element is already registered it is torn down via s() first, then mapped to its instance and observed by the IntersectionObserver when one exists. Keyed by element identity.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::p.oneLiner: Parses an href to URL, returns null and reports on failure
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::p.detail: Wraps createPrefetchURL in try/catch; on throw it logs via reportError (falling back to console.error) and returns null. Callers use null to mean "not prefetchable" (external/invalid hrefs).

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::q.oneLiner: Creates a link prefetch instance, registering it if enabled
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::q.detail: When prefetching is enabled and the href parses, builds an instance with prefetchHref and registers it via o(); otherwise returns an unregistered instance with prefetchHref null. Both paths start isVisible false and prefetchTask null.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::r.oneLiner: Registers a non-React link (e.g. form action) for prefetch
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::r.detail: Same as q but unconditional on an enable flag and with setOptimisticLinkStatus null; silently no-ops if the href won't parse. Returns nothing — caller keeps only the element.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::s.oneLiner: Unregisters a link and cancels its in-flight prefetch
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::s.detail: Removes the element from the instance map and the visible set, cancels any prefetchTask, and unobserves the element. Safe on unregistered elements.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::t.oneLiner: Updates a link's visibility and re-evaluates its prefetch
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::t.detail: Sets isVisible, adds/removes from the visible set, then calls v() at Default priority. Called from the IntersectionObserver callback.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::u.oneLiner: Bumps a link's prefetch to Intent priority on hover/touch
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::u.detail: Looks up the instance and calls v() with PrefetchPriority.Intent. The duplicated `void 0!==c` check is minifier residue, not logic.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::v.oneLiner: Cancels the prefetch task when a link is not visible
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::v.detail: Only the invisible branch is implemented in this build: it cancels prefetchTask and returns. Visible links fall through with no scheduling — the priority argument b is unused here, so scheduling happens only in w().

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::w.oneLiner: Reschedules prefetch tasks for all visible links
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::w.detail: For each visible instance, skips tasks still clean for the given (nextUrl, tree); otherwise cancels the old task and schedules a new one from createCacheKey at Default priority. Call after router state changes invalidate cache keys.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::c.oneLiner: Throwing stub for disabled Segment Cache experiment
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::c.detail: Placeholder export replacing the real segment-cache API; calling it throws an Error tagged __NEXT_ERROR_CODE E654. Reaching it means a code path assumed the experiment was on.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::j.e.oneLiner: Queues an async task, returns its promise
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::j.e.detail: Wraps `a` so it increments/decrements the running count and settles an externally-captured promise, then pushes it and triggers a drain. The returned promise is also the identity token `bump` matches on, so keep a reference if you want to reprioritize.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::j.b.oneLiner: Moves a queued task to front and runs it now
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::j.b.detail: Finds the entry whose `promiseFn` is the passed promise, splices it to the head of the queue, and drains with force=true — which bypasses the concurrency limit. No-op if the task already started or finished.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::j.c.oneLiner: Sets up private fields: limit, running count, queue
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::j.c.detail: Defines the private slots via Object.defineProperty (drain method non-writable, state fields writable) and initializes limit to the `a` argument, default 5. Running starts at 0, queue empty.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::m.oneLiner: Adds search params to PAGE segments in a state tree
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::m.detail: Walks the router state tree and rewrites any segment containing PAGE_SEGMENT_KEY to embed the given search params, so distinct query strings get distinct cache keys. Returns a new tree; children are recursed, other tuple slots preserved.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::D.oneLiner: True when URL is cross-origin from the page
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::D.detail: Plain origin comparison against `window.location.origin`. Browser-only — throws on the server.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::E.oneLiner: Builds a prefetch URL, or null if bot/cross-origin
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::E.detail: Returns null for bot user agents and for cross-origin targets, so callers skip prefetching. Applies basePath before parsing and throws error code E234 if the href can't be parsed as a URL.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::F.oneLiner: Effect component syncing router state to history
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::F.detail: In a useInsertionEffect it pushes or replaces history state carrying `__NA` and `__PRIVATE_NEXTJS_INTERNALS_TREE`; push only happens when pendingPush is set and the current href differs from the canonical URL. Renders null; the trailing empty useEffect on nextUrl/tree is a leftover no-op.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::G.detail: All RSC/head/loading slots null, empty parallelRoutes Map, navigatedAt -1. Every call allocates a new object and Map — don't share the result.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::H.oneLiner: Copies Next internal keys into a history state obj
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::H.detail: Preserves `__NA` and `__PRIVATE_NEXTJS_INTERNALS_TREE` from the current history state onto the caller's state object, defaulting it to {} when null. Mutates and returns the passed object, so user history state survives Next's monkey-patched pushState/replaceState.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::I.oneLiner: Deferred head value, with prefetchHead as initial
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::I.detail: Reads head and prefetchHead off the head CacheNode and returns useDeferredValue(head, prefetchHead ?? head), so the prefetched head renders immediately while the real one streams in. Handles a null cache node by yielding null.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::J.oneLiner: AppRouter body: history, contexts, error handling

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::K.oneLiner: AppRouter entry: wraps Router in a global ErrorBoundary
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::K.detail: Installs the nav-failure handler and renders `J` inside the default global error boundary, passing actionQueue, assetPrefix, and globalErrorState through. This is the component the app entry mounts.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::N.oneLiner: Renders <link> tags for dynamically added stylesheets
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::N.detail: Subscribes a forceUpdate callback to a module-level listener set `M` and renders one `<link rel="stylesheet" precedence="next">` per href in the module-level set `L`. Re-checks size on mount to catch stylesheets added between render and effect; keys are array indices, so ordering churn can remount links.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::e.oneLiner: Decodes flags from a server reference id's first byte
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::e.detail: Parses the first two hex chars of the id and unpacks: bit 7 → type ('use-cache' vs 'server-action'), bits 6–1 → usedArgs booleans for the first six parameters, bit 0 → hasRestArgs. apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.g.oneLiner: Flips state to hasError on any child throw
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.g.detail: Ignores the error object, returns `{hasError:true}`. No logging, no rethrow.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.c.oneLiner: Copies saved html attributes onto the <html> node

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.r.oneLiner: Renders rootHtml in <html> on error, else children
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.r.detail: Error branch injects `rootHtml` via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with suppressHydrationWarning to silence the mismatch. Empty `rootHtml` yields a blank document.

apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.c.oneLiner: Sets hasError false and empty html/attr placeholders
apps/web/.next/server/chunks/991.js::f.c.detail: Creates `htmlRef` for the error-path <html>. `rootHtml` and `htmlAttributes` start empty and must be populated by the surrounding code before an error occurs.
