apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Revali.detail: If `T` has a `revalidate` member, returns `NonNegative<T['revalidate']>`, else `never`. Feeds the compile-time check that an exported `revalidate` is a non-negative number.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::OmitWi.oneLiner: Omit plus an unused phantom message param
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::OmitWi.detail: Behaviorally identical to `Omit<T, K>`; `_M` exists only so the error message string shows up in tsc diagnostics when the type fails.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Diff.oneLiner: Extra members of T not present in Base
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Diff.detail: Returns `{}` when `T` is `any` (the `0 extends (1 & T)` any-detector), otherwise everything in `T` beyond `Base`'s keys. Non-empty result means the page exported something Next.js doesn't recognize, which triggers the error.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::FirstA.oneLiner: First parameter type of a function, any if unknown
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::FirstA.detail: Matches a two-parameter signature and infers arg 0; `unknown` collapses to `any` so untyped handlers pass. Yields `never` for non-matching signatures.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Second.oneLiner: Second parameter type of a function, any if unknown
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Second.detail: Mirror of FirstArg for arg 1 — the context/props object in route handlers and `generateMetadata`. Same `unknown` → `any` escape hatch.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::MaybeF.oneLiner: Field K of T if it's a function, else never
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::MaybeF.detail: Used to pull optional exports like `generateMetadata` or `generateStaticParams` off the module type without erroring when absent. Non-function values resolve to `never`.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::checkF.oneLiner: No-op generic that errors if its type arg has keys
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::checkF.detail: The type parameter is constrained to a record of all-`never` values, so instantiating it with a non-empty `Diff` fails to compile. Called with explicit type args and never invoked at runtime — the emitted body is empty.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Numeri.detail: Base constraint for the sign-checking types. Exists so `revalidate` can be validated for either literal form.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Zero.detail: Both numeric zero literals, needed because template-literal sign checks can't distinguish `-0` reliably. Special-cased before the negative test.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Negati.oneLiner: T if it's a negative literal, else never
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::Negati.detail: Stringifies `T` via template literal and matches a leading `-`; zero is excluded first. Only works on literal types — a plain `number` gives `never`.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::NonNeg.oneLiner: T if >= 0, else an error-message string literal
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::NonNeg.detail: Passes zero and non-negatives through; negatives resolve to `'__invalid_negative_number__'`, which then fails assignment and surfaces that string in the tsc error. A widened `number` slips through since `Negative` can't judge it.

apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::TEntry.oneLiner: Alias for the page.js module's full export shape
apps/web/.next/types/app/page.ts::TEntry.detail: Next.js codegen captures `typeof import('../../../app/page.js')` so the generated validator can check the route module's exports (default component, `metadata`, `generateStaticParams`, route segment config) against the App Router contract. Build-time only — it lives in `.next/types`, is regenerated on every build, and editing it does nothing.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-app-a4.oneLiner: Records module id as entry point, then requires it
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-app-a4.detail: Takes a webpack module id, assigns it to `e.s` (`__webpack_require__.s`, the entry-module marker read by chunk-loading/HMR runtime), and calls `e(id)` to execute the module, returning its exports. Mutates the shared require object as a side effect, so the last call wins — concurrent starts overwrite `e.s`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Sets ENOENT code and fixed middleware message
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: No inputs. Assigns code and message after super().

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: removeTrailingSlash, keeping root as "/"
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Drops a single trailing `/` and falls back to `/` when that empties the string. Only touches the end; query strings and hashes must already be split off.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Escapes regex metacharacters in a string
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Backslash-escapes . + * ? = ^ ! : $ {} () [] | / \ so literals can be embedded in a generated RegExp source. Pure.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Substitutes params into a non-path string (query, hash)
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Escapes path-to-regexp metacharacters while temporarily protecting `:param`, `:param*`, `:param?`, `:param+`, then compiles with the params and strips the synthetic leading `/`. Returns the input unchanged if it has no `:`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Cleans up after a drain pass, reruns if work arrived
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Only acts while draining: splices the current queue back in front of the pending queue, resets the index, and restarts d() if anything is left. Internal to the process.nextTick shim.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Returns the router singleton or throws
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `getRouter`: throws error code E394 ("No router instance found") if called before the router is created or on the server. Use inside client code only.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Queue item holding a callback and its args
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Constructor storing fun and array; a run() method on the prototype applies them. Used by the nextTick shim.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Production stub: returns first arg, drops the rest
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Collects variadic substitution args and ignores them, returning the message as-is. This is the stripped build of a dev-only error/warning formatter.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Returns "i" unless options.sensitive is set
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Flag helper for every RegExp built here — case-insensitive by default. Null-safe on the options argument.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Builds a cancelled "Route Cancelled" error
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Returns an `Error` tagged with non-enumerable `__NEXT_ERROR_CODE: "E315"` and `cancelled: true`. Callers check `.cancelled` to swallow it instead of reporting a navigation failure.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Async: does middleware match this navigation target?
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Loads the middleware manifest via `pageLoader.getMiddleware()`; returns false if absent. Otherwise strips basePath from `asPath`, re-adds locale and basePath, and tests it against each entry's `regexp`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Strips the current origin off an absolute URL
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Removes the `getLocationOrigin()` prefix if present, else returns the input unchanged. Turns same-origin absolute URLs into path-relative ones; cross-origin URLs pass through.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Resolves href/as into final {url, as} for navigation
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Runs `resolveHref(router, href, true)`, strips same-origin prefixes, and adds basePath only to URLs that weren't already absolute-with-origin. Third arg `as` overrides the resolved as-path; result feeds `router.push`/`replace`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Maps a concrete path to its dynamic page route
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Denormalizes and trailing-slash-normalizes the path, returns it as-is for `/404` and `/_error`, otherwise returns the first page in list `t` whose route regex matches. Falls back to the input path when nothing matches; first match wins, so page-list order matters.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Fetches route data and computes the middleware effect
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Returns null when no middleware matches (`U`) or `fetchData` is missing; otherwise fetches and reads `x-nextjs-rewrite`/`x-nextjs-matched-path`/`x-nextjs-redirect` headers into an `effect` of type `rewrite`, `redirect-internal`, `redirect-external`, or `next`. Rewrites require the page list plus client build manifest, so this awaits network work; the matched-path header is ignored for `/404`, `/_error`, and data catchall.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Converts an array-like to a real array
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Array.prototype.slice on the argument. Used for NodeList and HTMLCollection results.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Fetches Next data JSON with dedupe, retry, and caching
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Keys `inflightCache` by absolute href and returns the in-flight/cached promise unless `unstable_skipClientCache`; sends `x-nextjs-data: 1`, retries up to 3x on 5xx during server render, uses HEAD when `isBackground`, and maps a 404 with `notFound` to a sentinel. Cache entry is dropped on failure or when the response carries `x-middleware-cache: no-cache`; network-level failures are tagged via `markAssetError` so the router does a hard navigation.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Root container: error catching, hash scroll, SSG hydration fixup
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Renders children unchanged; all work is in lifecycle hooks. Wraps the page tree in the Next.js client entry.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Boots the Next.js client runtime, returns assetPrefix
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Parses `__NEXT_DATA__` from the DOM, sets webpack public path and runtime config, creates the PageLoader, and drains `window.__NEXT_P` (replacing its `push` with the entrypoint handler). Heavy module-global mutation (`a`, `h`, `i`, `s`, `u`, `o`); must run before anything else.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Renders a component with props as a JSX element
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `renderApp`: one-line wrapper around `jsx(Component, props)`. Exists so App rendering goes through a single call site.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Wraps children in all pages-router context providers
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `AppContainer`: nests error boundary plus AppRouter, SearchParams, Pathname, PathParams, Router, HeadManager and ImageConfig providers around `children`. Boundary catches render errors and hands them to `$` (renderError); image sizes are hardcoded at build time.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Full browser reload of the current page
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Calls window.location.reload(). Discards all client router state — not an SPA navigation.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Go back one history entry
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Thin wrapper over window.history.back(). Navigation happens via the popstate handler, not synchronously.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Go forward one history entry
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Thin wrapper over window.history.forward(). Same async popstate path as back().

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Navigate and add a history entry
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Normalizes (url, as) through F — resolves relative hrefs and applies locale/basePath — then delegates to change('pushState', ...). Returns change()'s Promise<boolean>; options default to {}.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Navigate, replacing current history entry
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Identical to push() but calls change('replaceState', ...), so no new history entry. Returns Promise<boolean>.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Bloom-filter check: does this path belong elsewhere?
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Lazily builds static/dynamic BloomFilters from the client build manifest, then tests `as` and `resolvedAs` (plus every path prefix, for dynamic routes) with and without basePath/locale. On a hit it either returns true (when the dry-run flag `a` is set) or triggers a hard navigation via z() and returns a never-resolving Promise to freeze the SPA until unload.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Core navigation: history, data fetch, render
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Resolves rewrites and dynamic-route params, consults middleware, calls getRouteInfo for component + props, updates history via changeState, then renders and scrolls. Gotchas: returns a never-resolving Promise whenever it falls back to a hard navigation; hash-only changes short-circuit early with hashChangeStart/Complete; `_h === 1` means a query-update re-render, not a real navigation.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Write the URL into window.history
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Calls history.pushState/replaceState with a Next-shaped state ({url, as, options, __N:true, key}). Skips pushState entirely when the target URL equals the current one; only pushState mints a fresh scroll-restoration key.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Fall back to /_error when route loading fails
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Rethrows cancelled errors; on asset-load errors (or the `o` retry flag) emits routeChangeError and forces a hard navigation. Otherwise loads /_error, runs its getInitialProps, and recurses once with o=true if even that fails.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Load component + props for a route
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Fetches the page bundle and its SSG/SSP JSON (or runs getInitialProps for plain pages), applying middleware effects — rewrite retargets the route, redirect-internal/external is returned as-is for change() to act on. Caches the result in this.components; SSP responses and x-middleware-skip hits are evicted from `sdc`, and SSG pages get a background revalidate into `sbc`. Errors route to handleRouteInfoError.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Commit router state and re-render
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Assigns this.state then calls this.sub(component, appComponent, resetScroll) — the subscription installed by the app bootstrap. Returns sub()'s promise; the only place state and the React tree update together.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Register a back/forward interception callback
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Stores the callback in this._bps. The popstate handler calls it and aborts the SPA navigation if it returns false, letting the browser handle it.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: True if the target differs from current only by hash
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Compares asPath split on '#': same pathname plus either an equal target hash or a differing hash. Returns false when asPath is unset, and false for same-path-no-hash-either-side.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Scroll to the fragment target of a URL
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Empty hash or '#top' scrolls to (0,0); otherwise decodes the fragment and tries getElementById, then the first element with a matching name, calling scrollIntoView. Wrapped in disableSmoothScrollDuringRouteTransition so CSS smooth scrolling is suppressed on real route changes.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: True if the given asPath differs from the current one
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Plain string inequality against this.asPath. change() uses it to downgrade a pushState to replaceState for same-URL navigations.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Warm caches for a route's bundle and data
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Bails immediately for bot user agents; otherwise resolves rewrites/dynamic params, prefetches SSG JSON into `sdc`, and loads the page chunk (loadPage when options.priority, else prefetch). A _bfl hit marks the route as `{__appRouter:true}` so later navigations hard-load it; redirect-external effects abort silently.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Load a route's page chunk with cancellation
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Wraps pageLoader.loadPage in V(), which registers the load so an interrupting navigation can cancel it. The cancel handle is cleared on both success and failure, and the error is rethrown.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Run a data fetch that a newer navigation can cancel
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Sets this.clc to a canceller before awaiting the callback; if it fired, throws an error with `.cancelled = true` instead of returning data. Only clears this.clc when it still owns it, so a later navigation's canceller is not clobbered.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Run a page's getInitialProps with App context
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Builds AppTree from the cached /_app component via this._wrapApp, injects it into ctx, and delegates to loadGetInitialProps on the App component. Mutates the passed ctx object.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Current route id (dynamic pattern, not filled URL)
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Getter for this.state.route, e.g. '/posts/[id]'. Read-only; changes only through set().

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Current page path without query or hash
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Getter for this.state.pathname. Post-rewrite and basePath-stripped, so it can differ from what is in the URL bar.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Current query params plus dynamic route params
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Getter for this.state.query. Empty on the first render of statically optimized pages until isReady flips true.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Path shown in the URL bar, locale stripped
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Getter for this.state.asPath, including query and hash. This is the filled-in URL, the counterpart to `route`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Active i18n locale
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Getter for this.state.locale. Undefined when i18n is not configured in next.config.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Getter: true while rendering a fallback page
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Reads `this.state.isFallback`, set from the constructor option and updated on route changes. True means SSG params aren't resolved yet, so page data is absent.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Getter: true when preview/draft mode is active
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Reads `this.state.isPreview`, seeded from the constructor's `isPreview` flag. Never mutated outside router state updates.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Boots the pages Router: state, caches, popstate handler
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Seeds `components` with the initial page and `/_app`, sets route/pathname/query/asPath state, computes `isReady` from `__NEXT_DATA__` flags, and registers the `popstate` listener. Also kicks off `_initialMatchesMiddlewarePromise` and a `replaceState` to normalize the URL, unless `as` starts with `//`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Reads the status code out of an error digest
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Takes the part after `;` in `error.digest` and returns it as a Number. Assumes the digest already passed the `o` type guard — no validation, throws on missing digest.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Maps 401/403/404 to fallback route names
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Returns "unauthorized", "forbidden", or "not-found"; any other status yields undefined. Used to pick which special app-router file renders.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: True if value is in module-level Set u
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: One-line membership test against the closure Set `u`. No mutation; whatever populates `u` elsewhere defines the meaning.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Global error handler; unwraps cause, skips CSR bailout
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: If e is an Error with a `cause`, reports the cause instead of e; bailout-to-CSR errors (Next's signal to fall back to client rendering) are swallowed, everything else goes to reportGlobalError. Only unwraps one level of cause.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Adds one route path to the trie
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Splits on `/`, drops empty segments, and delegates to `_insert` with an empty seen-slugs list. Throws on malformed dynamic segments.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Flattens the trie into routes ordered by specificity
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Emits literal children alphabetically first, then `[slug]`, then `[...rest]`, then `[[...rest]]`, prefixing each with the accumulated path. Throws E458 if a concrete route sits at the same level as an optional catch-all.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Recursively inserts segments and validates slug names
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Normalizes `[x]`/`[...x]`/`[[...x]]` into bucket keys while recording slug names, and rejects duplicate, conflicting, or near-identical slugs, stray brackets, leading dots, `…`, and catch-alls that aren't last. Mutates `t` (the seen-slug list) as it descends.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Next.js App root: renders page component with pageProps
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Pulls Component and pageProps off props and returns a single JSX element. Default _app when the project has no custom one.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: useRouter hook: reads router from React context
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Throws error code E509 ("NextRouter was not mounted") when no RouterContext provider is above it. Unlike `d`, this is context-scoped, so it works during render.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Getter exposing the singleton Next.js router
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Reads the module-level router instance. Undefined before the client router is created.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Builds the bailout error with prefixed message
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Prefixes "Bail out to client-side rendering: " onto the reason and sets .reason and .digest. Digest is the shared module constant, not per-instance.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Forwards render errors to the props.fn handler
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Passes (error, errorInfo) up; does not set state or swallow. Rendering continues to be children, so recovery is the handler's job.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Scrolls to hash and replays query string after SSR/SSG
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: On SSR pages that are fallback, next-export dynamic routes, or __N_SSG, calls router.replace merging the router query with the live location.search so client state matches the URL. Uses {_h:1, shallow} to mark hydration; rethrows non-cancelled replace errors.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Re-runs hash scrolling after each update
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Fires on every update, not just navigations. Harmless when the hash is empty or the target is missing.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Scrolls the element matching location.hash into view
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Strips the leading "#", looks the id up with getElementById, and scrolls in a setTimeout 0 so the DOM has painted. No-op when there is no hash or no matching element; ignores name anchors.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Renders children unchanged
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Pure passthrough — the component exists only for its lifecycle hooks. Adds no DOM node.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Builds AppTree: wraps a component with router/App context
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `wrapApp`: curried — takes App, returns a component that merges `{Component, err, router}` into passed props and renders it inside `Y`. Passed to the router and to `getInitialProps` ctx as `AppTree`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Renders the error page after a client-side exception
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `renderError`: logs the error, loads `/_error` via the page loader, falls back to the bundled default error page + default App if `/_error` is the currently-rendered page, runs `getInitialProps`, then calls `ei` (doRender). Always logs to console even when recovery succeeds.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Invisible component that fires a callback on layout effect
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Renders `null`; runs `callback` in `useLayoutEffect` so it fires synchronously after React commits DOM mutations but before paint. Used to swap stylesheet `media` attributes and restore scroll without flicker.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Clears the four Next.js perf marks
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `clearMarks`: `performance.clearMarks` for beforeRender, afterHydrate, afterRender, routeChange. Called after each measure pass so the next navigation starts clean.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Measures and reports hydration timing
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `markHydrateComplete`: marks afterHydrate, measures `beforeHydration` (navigationStart→beforeRender) and `hydration` (beforeRender→afterHydrate), pipes results to the reportWebVitals handler, then clears marks. No-op unless `performance` support flag `ST` is true.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Measures and reports client navigation render timing
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `markRenderComplete`: marks afterRender, measures `routeChangeToRender` and `render`, reports them, then clears both marks and measures. Silently skips if the routeChange or beforeRender mark is missing.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Runs callbacks on layout effect, renders children
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `Root`: fires every function in `callbacks` inside `useLayoutEffect`, returns `children` unchanged. Carries the perf-mark callback and the render-promise resolver so they fire exactly when React commits.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Core render: mounts or hydrates the page into #__next
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `doRender`: injects any missing `<style data-n-href>` tags hidden with `media="x"`, builds the tree (AppContainer + route announcer portal), then `hydrateRoot` on first pass or `root.render` in a `startTransition` after. Returns a promise resolved on commit or rejected with a `cancelled` "Cancel rendering route" error if a newer render supersedes it.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Render entry point with error fallback
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Routes to `$` (error page) when the payload carries an error, otherwise calls `ei` and catches thrown errors into `$`. Re-throws cancellation errors so superseded navigations don't render an error page.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Loads _app and the initial page, creates router, hydrates
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `hydrate`: awaits the `/_app` and current-page entrypoints, wires `reportWebVitals` (normalizing id/name/startTime/value/label), awaits `__NEXT_PRELOADREADY` for dynamic ids, creates the singleton router with `eu` as its render subscription, then calls `eu` with `isHydratePass: true`. Load failures are caught and forwarded as `err` instead of throwing.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Runs a callback now, or queues it until the router exists
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Method on the `next/router` singleton. Callbacks queued before `_`/createRouter runs are flushed once by it; queueing after mount still executes immediately.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Creates the router singleton and flushes ready callbacks
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `createRouter`: forwards all args to the Router constructor, stores it on the singleton, calls and clears every queued `readyCallbacks`, returns the router. Calling twice replaces the existing instance.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Builds a safe public copy of the router instance
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: `makePublicRouterInstance`: shallow-clones whitelisted fields (deep-copying object/array ones so consumers can't mutate internals), reattaches the shared `events` emitter, and binds the whitelisted methods back to the real router. Reads are a snapshot — fields won't update after copy; methods stay live.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Bloom filter: k bit indices for a value
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Runs an inlined MurmurHash2-style mix over the string `value+i` for i=1..numHashes, mods each by numBits, returns the array of bit positions. Pure; the salt is appended as a decimal digit, so numHashes>9 shifts the input length and the hashes are unsigned 32-bit.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Closes a span and notifies the tracer
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Throws Next error E17 if already ended, otherwise records endTime (defaults to Date.now()) and invokes the onSpanEnd callback. Not idempotent by design.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Builds a span from name, options, end callback
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Defaults attributes to {} and startTime to Date.now(), stores the tracer's onSpanEnd, and sets state to inprogress. The attributes object is stored by reference, not copied.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Creates a span wired to this tracer
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Returns a new Span with the tracer's handleSpanEnd bound in. Does not track the span itself — you must hold the reference to end it.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Subscribes to ended spans; returns unsubscribe
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Registers the listener on the `spanend` event and returns a function that removes it. Only fires for spans whose `end()` was called.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.oneLiner: Sets up the emitter and end handler
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/main-2a5bc2.detail: Creates the emitter instance and defines handleSpanEnd as an arrow field so it stays bound when passed to spans. No listeners registered by default.

services/api/horolog/api.py::_localise.detail: Returns the value untouched if None or already tz-aware, otherwise `replace(tzinfo=zone)` — no wall-clock shift, so 09:00 naive stays 09:00 local. Wired as a field validator on the `LocalDateTime` alias so every wire model gets it; `to_slot` rejects naive datetimes and would 500 without it.

services/api/horolog/api.py::analytics.oneLiner: GET: how the current plan spends the week
services/api/horolog/api.py::analytics.detail: Reuses the stored plan, replanning only if none exists, then feeds it plus intents and all `BusyRow`s (mapped to `BusyInterval`) into `analyse` with the configured horizon and workday bounds. Read-only apart from the fallback `_replan`, which does commit a fresh plan.

services/api/horolog/api.py::IcsSyncIn.detail: Single field, 1-2000 chars. No scheme or host validation here — the URL is fetched server-side by `ICSProvider`, so SSRF is bounded only by whatever that provider does.

services/api/horolog/api.py::sync_ics.oneLiner: POST: mirror a published .ics feed into busy rows
services/api/horolog/api.py::sync_ics.detail: Builds an `ICSProvider` over the URL in the configured zone and hands it to `_mirror` under source "ics". Returns `{events, blocks}`; needs no OAuth since Google and Outlook both expose a secret iCal address.

services/api/horolog/api.py::CalDavSyncI.oneLiner: Request body: CalDAV URL plus optional credentials
services/api/horolog/api.py::CalDavSyncI.detail: URL is required (1-2000 chars); username and password default to empty for unauthenticated servers. Credentials arrive in plaintext in the request body and are passed straight to the provider, not stored.

services/api/horolog/api.py::sync_caldav.oneLiner: POST: mirror a CalDAV calendar into busy rows
services/api/horolog/api.py::sync_caldav.detail: Same shape as `sync_ics` with a `CalDAVProvider` and source "caldav", so the two mirrors never clobber each other. Returns `{events, blocks}`.

services/api/horolog/api.py::export_ics.oneLiner: GET: plan as a downloadable .ics calendar
services/api/horolog/api.py::export_ics.detail: Loads the stored plan (replanning if absent), maps each block's intent_id to its title, converts slot indices back to datetimes via `from_slot(..., origin())`, and returns text/calendar with a `horolog.ics` attachment disposition. Read-only for subscribers; a block whose intent was deleted falls back to showing its raw id.

services/api/horolog/api.py::_mirror.oneLiner: Replace one source's busy rows from a provider, re-plan
services/api/horolog/api.py::_mirror.detail: Fetches events over the configured horizon (provider `SyncError` → HTTP 502), deletes every `BusyRow` with that `source`, inserts the fetched ones with `{source}:{uuid12}` ids, commits, then re-plans and returns `{events, blocks}`. Replace-not-merge is deliberate so upstream deletions free their slots — row ids are regenerated each sync, so nothing may hold a reference to them.

services/api/tests/test_api.py::test_acc.oneLiner: PUT /api/busy with tz-naive ISO strings must not 400/500
services/api/tests/test_api.py::test_acc.detail: Posts one busy block whose start/end come from origin() stripped of tzinfo, offset by a day, then reads /api/plan back. Asserts 200 and that the returned start parses with a non-None tzinfo, i.e. the API localized the floating time into the configured zone instead of rejecting it; regression guard for ICS imports and browser toISOString payloads.

apps/web/app/components/Shell.tsx::Shell.oneLiner: App layout: sidebar nav, ⌘K command bar, live plan feed
apps/web/app/components/Shell.tsx::Shell.detail: Renders a sticky desktop sidebar plus a horizontal mobile nav from the module-level NAV/ICONS constants, marking the entry matching usePathname() as active, and wraps children with CommandBar. Takes optional onPlanChange, fired both when CommandBar reports a capture and on every server-sent "plan" event.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Loads a module: cache hit, else execute and cache.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Takes a module id, returns `module.exports`; on a miss it creates the module record, runs the factory from `__webpack_modules__`, marks `loaded`, and stores it in `__webpack_module_cache__`. Everything else (chunk loading, HMR, public path) hangs off it as properties, so it is the single entry point of the runtime.

Receives the previous handler (chained) and the DOM event, clears the load timeout, removes the `<script>` tag, and rejects the pending `installedChunks[chunkId]` promise with a `ChunkLoadError` carrying `event.type` and `event.target.src`. Fires for both `onerror` and the timeout path, so a success that never called the chunk's push still lands here as a failure.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Per-module require that records HMR parent/child links.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Wraps `__webpack_require__` for one owning `moduleId`: on each call it pushes the child id onto the parent's `children` and the parent id onto the child's `parents`, then copies over `.cache`, `.m`, `.hmrM` and friends. That parent graph is what `hotApply` walks to bubble an update upward; a module required outside this wrapper is invisible to HMR.

Given a module id and its module record `me`, returns the `hot` object with `accept`, `decline`, `dispose`/`addDisposeHandler`, `invalidate`, `check`, `apply`, `status`, and the `_acceptedDependencies`/`_declinedDependencies` maps the apply logic reads. Called fresh for every (re)instantiation, so handlers registered on an old instance die with it.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Sets HMR status and fires status handlers.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Writes the module-level `currentStatus` (`idle`, `check`, `prepare`, `ready`, `dispose`, `apply`, `abort`, `fail`) and synchronously calls every callback registered via `hot.addStatusHandler`. Ordering matters: `hotApply` refuses to run unless status is `ready`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Releases one blocker; runs queued work at zero.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Decrements the outstanding blocking-promise count and, when it hits zero, drains the queued callbacks from `waitForBlockingPromises` and clears the queue. Called from both the fulfill and reject paths, so a failed promise still unblocks.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Registers a promise HMR must wait on.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: If the argument is a thenable, increments the blocking count and attaches `unblock` to both settle paths, returning the promise unchanged; non-thenables pass through untouched. Used for async module factories so an update is not applied mid-await.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Runs fn now, or after all blocking promises settle.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: With no outstanding blockers it calls `fn()` immediately and returns its result; otherwise it pushes `fn` onto the deferred queue and returns undefined. Callers must tolerate both the sync and deferred shapes.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Fetches the update manifest and hot-update chunks.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Requires status `idle`, moves to `check`, GETs `<hash>.hot-update.json`, then loads every listed update chunk via `loadUpdateChunk` and settles at `ready` with the changed module ids; if `applyOnUpdate` is truthy it chains straight into `internalApply`. Resolves `null` when the manifest 404s (server restarted with a new hash) — that is the signal to full-reload, not an error.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Public entry to apply a downloaded HMR update.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Thin guard: throws unless status is `ready`, then delegates to `internalApply(options)`. `options.ignoreUnaccepted`, `ignoreDeclined`, `ignoreErrored`, and `onDeclined`/`onErrored` callbacks are passed through.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Does the real dispose/re-execute work of an update.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Collects `applyHandler` results from every runtime, computes outdated modules by bubbling from changed modules to their accepting parents, runs dispose handlers, deletes those entries from the module cache, installs the new factories, then re-requires the accept handlers; returns the applied module ids. Bubbling that reaches a self-declining or unaccepted root aborts the whole update (status `abort`/`fail`) and the caller should full-reload.

Drains the `queuedInvalidatedModules` set that `hot.invalidate()` fills while dispose/accept handlers run, and re-enters the apply pass for them. Loops until the set is empty, so an invalidate storm can iterate more than once.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Injects a <link> for a chunk's CSS.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Builds `<link rel="stylesheet" href=fullhref>`, wires `onload`→`resolve` and `onerror`→`reject` (after detaching the node), applies nonce/crossOrigin, and appends to `<head>`. Mutates the DOM before the promise settles, so a rejected load can leave a removed tag and a half-styled page.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Finds an already-present <link> for that href.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Scans `document.querySelectorAll("link")` (and preloaded/`data-href` variants) for a tag whose href matches the relative `href` or absolute `fullhref`, returning it or undefined. Prevents duplicate injection when SSR already emitted the stylesheet.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Promise for a chunk's stylesheet; skips if present.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Resolves immediately when `findStylesheet` hits, otherwise resolves the full URL from `__webpack_require__.p` + the CSS filename template and defers to `createStylesheet`. Returns a promise the chunk-load ensure chain awaits alongside the JS.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Runtime-specific HMR handler: dispose + apply pair.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Called by `internalApply` per runtime module (JS, CSS, etc.) with the apply options; returns `{dispose, apply}` closures plus the outdated-module bookkeeping for that runtime. The CSS variant swaps the `<link>` tag; the JS variant purges cache entries and installs new factories — both run in two phases, so side effects belong in `apply`, not at handler-construction time.

Reads `installedChunks[chunkId]`; if the entry is still an array the chunk never executed its push, so it rejects with a `ChunkLoadError` typed by `event.type` (`load` = empty/missing chunk, `error`/`timeout` = network), otherwise it clears the entry to `0`. Returning early on an already-cleared entry is how double-fire is tolerated.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.oneLiner: Loads a hot-update chunk and records its module ids.
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/webpack.js:.detail: Appends `<hash>.hot-update.js` via the script loader; the chunk's self-registering push fills `currentUpdate` with new factories, and the ids are pushed onto `updatedModulesList` for the caller. Rejects on script failure — `hotCheck` treats that as a failed update, not a partial one.

apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::Slice.oneLiner: One labeled bucket of minutes plus its fraction
apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::Slice.detail: Breakdown row: label, absolute minutes, and share (fraction of a total). Used for by_kind and by_priority; share is redundant with minutes, so trust whichever the server computes.

apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::DayLoad.oneLiner: Per-day time totals within the planning horizon
apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::DayLoad.detail: day is an index/offset, not a date. scheduled_minutes and meeting_minutes may overlap depending on server semantics; longest_free_run_minutes is the biggest uninterrupted gap that day.

apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::Analytics.oneLiner: Full schedule stats payload for the analytics view
apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::Analytics.detail: Aggregates over horizon_days at window_minutes_per_day capacity: focus/meeting/scheduled/unmet minutes, meeting_load and fragmentation ratios, longest_focus_run_minutes, after_hours_minutes, plus by_kind/by_priority slices and per-day days. Mirrors the backend response shape exactly — field renames on the server silently break consumers since it's a compile-time-only contract.

apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::createIntent.oneLiner: POSTs an intent to /api/intents, returns the created Intent
apps/web/app/lib/api.ts::createIntent.detail: Takes an untyped Record<string, unknown> body, JSON-stringifies it, delegates to request<Intent>. No client-side validation or Content-Type set here — both are the caller's or request()'s job; body shape errors surface only as server errors.

apps/web/app/inbox/page.tsx::Inbox.oneLiner: Inbox page: intents joined to their scheduled blocks
apps/web/app/inbox/page.tsx::Inbox.detail: On mount loads intents and plan in parallel, then per intent collects its blocks, sums scheduled minutes, and sorts unmet-shortfall first, then priority, then next block start. remove(id) deletes via api and refetches; busy holds the in-flight id to disable that row's button, and every failure lands in one shared error banner.

apps/web/app/habits/page.tsx::clock.detail: Takes an integer minute offset, returns zero-padded 24h time for `<input type="time">` values. No wraparound: 1500 yields "25:00", and negatives produce garbage.

apps/web/app/habits/page.tsx::toMinutes.detail: Inverse of `clock`, used in time input onChange handlers. Empty or malformed input yields NaN since `Number("")` on missing parts is defaulted to "0" but non-numeric text is not.

apps/web/app/habits/page.tsx::Habits.oneLiner: Habits page: list recurring intents, create new ones
apps/web/app/habits/page.tsx::Habits.detail: Loads intents and plan in parallel via `api.intents()`/`api.plan()` on mount and after any save, keeps form state for title/frequency/duration/window/priority, and posts through `createIntent` with `kind:"habit"`, `period_days:7`, and `minutes_per_period = times * minutes`. `save` no-ops on blank title, in-flight save, or `windowTooSmall` (window shorter than one session); `Shell`'s `onPlanChange` re-runs `load` so plan edits elsewhere refresh this page.

apps/web/app/habits/page.tsx::Field.oneLiner: Label + hint wrapper around a form control
apps/web/app/habits/page.tsx::Field.detail: Presentational only: renders a `<label>` with bold label text and a muted hint, then `children`. Uses implicit label association by wrapping the control, so nested inputs need no `htmlFor`/`id` pair.

apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::Analyti.oneLiner: Analytics route: fetches metrics, renders tiles and charts
apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::Analyti.detail: Calls analytics.get() on mount and again whenever Shell fires onPlanChange; stores result or an error string in state. Nothing renders below the header until data arrives, and error/data are independent — a failed reload leaves stale data on screen alongside the error banner.

apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::Stat.oneLiner: Stat tile: big value, label, sub-note, optional danger tint
apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::Stat.detail: Pure presentational; value is pre-formatted by the caller, no numbers computed here. warn only recolors the value to text-danger — it adds no icon or aria, so the alert state is color-only.

apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::LegendK.oneLiner: Legend swatch plus text label for one chart series
apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::LegendK.detail: Swatch is an inline-styled div with aria-hidden; the label text carries the meaning for screen readers. color is a raw CSS color string, not a Tailwind class.

apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::DayChar.oneLiner: Stacked per-day bars for scheduled + meeting minutes
apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::DayChar.detail: Takes the first 14 entries of data.days; bar heights scale against a ceiling of max(window_minutes_per_day, largest day total) over 148px, so bars never overflow. Dates come from new Date() offset by day.day — computed at render, so a day index of 0 means today, not a fixed calendar date; zero-total days draw a 3px stub and every nonzero segment is floored at 2px.

apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::Breakdo.oneLiner: Labelled horizontal bar list of minutes by category
apps/web/app/analytics/page.tsx::Breakdo.detail: Expects rows sorted descending — bar widths are relative to rows[0].minutes, so an unsorted array produces bars wider than 100%. Empty array renders a placeholder line; shade fades 14% per row via color-mix, so past ~7 rows the bars are effectively the line color.

apps/web/app/connect/page.tsx::Result.oneLiner: Sync outcome: success count, error message, or idle
apps/web/app/connect/page.tsx::Result.detail: Discriminated union on `ok`, plus `null` for "nothing tried yet". Drives the banner: green with `events`, red with `message`, or hidden.

apps/web/app/connect/page.tsx::Connect.oneLiner: Calendar page: ICS feed and CalDAV sync forms
apps/web/app/connect/page.tsx::Connect.detail: Client component holding form state (`icsUrl`, `dav`), an in-flight marker (`pending`, also the disabled/label switch for both buttons), and the last `result`. Loads the plan on mount via `load` and reloads after each successful sync so the header counts refresh.

apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.oneLiner: Maps route param keys to string | string[] | undefined
apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.detail: For a record type, each string-valued property widens to `string | string[] | undefined`; non-string properties become `never`. Non-record `T` passes through unchanged. The widening reflects catch-all segments (`[...slug]`) and missing params.

apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.oneLiner: Props shape a page component must accept
apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.detail: `params` and `searchParams` are both Promises — App Router async props, so a page must await them. Both optional so pages that ignore them still typecheck.

apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.oneLiner: Props shape a layout component must accept
apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.detail: Same `params` Promise as PageProps, plus `children`; no `searchParams` because layouts don't receive them. Unused here except when the segment has a layout.

apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.oneLiner: Extracts revalidate and rejects negative values
apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.detail: If `T` has a `revalidate` member, returns `NonNegative<T['revalidate']>`, else `never`. Feeds the compile-time check that an exported `revalidate` is a non-negative number.

apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.oneLiner: Omit plus an unused phantom message param
apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.detail: Behaviorally identical to `Omit<T, K>`; `_M` exists only so the error message string shows up in tsc diagnostics when the type fails.

apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.oneLiner: Extra members of T not present in Base
apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.detail: Returns `{}` when `T` is `any` (the `0 extends (1 & T)` any-detector), otherwise everything in `T` beyond `Base`'s keys. Non-empty result means the page exported something Next.js doesn't recognize, which triggers the error.

apps/web/.next/types/app/connect/page.ts.oneLiner: First parameter type of a function, any if unknown

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Creates the iterator constructor, then walks up the existing native iterator's prototype chain and repairs it — fixing @@iterator, toStringTag, and Firefox's mis-named values method. Exports keys/values/entries either directly onto the prototype (FORCED path) or via the $ export helper, and sets proto[@@iterator].

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: createIterResultObject: builds {value, done}
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Two args straight into a fresh object literal. No validation, no side effects.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: iteratorClose: calls the iterator's return method
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Looks up return, invokes it, and swallows its throw unless the caller wasn't already throwing. With kind "throw" the caller's error always wins; otherwise a bad return value or non-object result throws.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Runs a callback, closing the iterator if it throws
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: With ENTRIES set, splits the entry into (key, value) and asserts it is an object first. Any throw from the callback triggers iteratorClose(iterator, "throw", err) and re-raises.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: isArrayIteratorMethod: true for the stock array iterator
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Matches undefined, Iterators.Array, or the Arguments iterator. Lets callers take the fast index-loop path instead of the iterator protocol.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: createProperty: define-or-assign an own property
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Uses defineProperty with a plain data descriptor when descriptors are supported, else a bare assignment. Bypasses inherited setters, unlike plain assignment on old engines.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: getIteratorMethod: finds @@iterator or a registry entry
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns undefined for null/undefined input. Checks Symbol.iterator, the "@@iterator" string fallback, then Iterators[classof(obj)] for engines lacking symbols.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: getIterator: calls the iterator method, asserts an object
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Second arg overrides method lookup. Throws TypeError "X is not iterable" when no callable method exists, and anObject-checks the returned iterator.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Array.from implementation
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Iterable input goes through the iterator protocol with mapfn errors closing the iterator; array-likes use a plain length loop. Called on a constructor it news that up, otherwise builds a plain Array, and sets length explicitly at the end.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Feature detect: does a method consume iterators properly
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Feeds the method a fake iterable whose iterator reports done immediately and reports whether next was actually called. Returns false early when SKIP_CLOSING and native iterator support is absent, and swallows all throws.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: defineBuiltInAccessor: names get/set then defines it
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Stamps proper function names on the descriptor's getter/setter ("get x"/"set x") before calling defineProperty. Descriptor is passed through unchanged otherwise.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Attaches hidden metadata (objectID, weakData) to an object
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Installs a non-enumerable internal slot holding a fresh "O<n>" id and an empty weakData bag. Backs WeakMap/WeakSet fallbacks and object identity on engines without native weak collections.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Result box for the iterate helper: {stopped, result}
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Plain constructor, two fields. Signals early termination back to iterate's caller.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: iterate: the shared iteration driver for core-js
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Options flags select behavior — AS_ENTRIES splits [k,v] pairs, IS_RECORD/IS_ITERATOR skip method lookup, INTERRUPTED passes a stop callback, that binds the callback receiver. Array-iterator inputs take a fast index loop; otherwise any callback throw closes the iterator, and returning a Result stops early.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: anInstance: throws unless value instanceof the constructor
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns the value on success, throws TypeError "Incorrect invocation" otherwise. Guards collection methods against being called on foreign receivers.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: inheritIfRequired: repoints a wrapper's prototype on subclass
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: When a polyfilled constructor is subclassed, retargets the new instance to the subclass prototype via setPrototypeOf. No-ops when setPrototypeOf is unavailable or the constructor matches the wrapper.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Builds a polyfilled Map/Set/WeakMap/WeakSet class
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Picks add/set method name from the collection name, detects broken natives via feature probes, and either builds a fresh constructor from the internal implementation or patches the native prototype methods. Patched methods normalize -0 to 0 and make weak collections return false/undefined for primitive keys; result is exported to global and given a toStringTag.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Defines many methods on a target at once
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Loops the source object and calls the single-method definer for each key with shared options (name, enumerable, non-writable, etc). Returns the target.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Adds a Symbol.species getter returning this
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Looks up the global constructor by name and, if accessors are supported and the getter is absent, installs a configurable `get [Symbol.species]() { return this }`. No-op on engines without descriptor support.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Inserts or updates one entry in the Map/Set state
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Reuses an existing entry's value slot if the key is present; otherwise appends a node to the doubly-linked entry list, bumps size, and indexes it by hash unless the hash is "F" (non-hashable/frozen object, found by scan instead). Mutates the collection and returns it.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Finds a Map/Set entry node by key
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Hashable keys hit the index bucket directly; keys hashing to "F" fall back to a linear walk of the linked list using ===. Returns the entry node or undefined.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Makes a DOM collection prototype iterable
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Force-assigns Symbol.iterator = Array.prototype.values (with try/catch for non-writable props), sets the toStringTag, and for whitelisted collections copies keys/values/entries off the Array iterator methods. Swallows assignment failures on locked-down host objects.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Factory producing Map.from / Set.from
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns a static `from(iterable, mapFn, thisArg)` that constructs the collection and iterate-adds each item, applying the optional mapper with an index. In map mode each produced item is treated as a [key, value] pair.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Factory producing Map.of / Set.of
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns a variadic static that news up the collection and adds each argument. In map mode each argument is destructured as a [key, value] pair.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Asserts value is a real Map/Set, then returns it
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Runs the brand check for its side effect (throws TypeError on foreign objects) and passes the argument through, so it can wrap an expression inline.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Walks an iterator until callback yields non-undefined
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Pulls from the iterator record (or the raw iterator when the flag is set), calling the callback per value. Returns the first non-undefined callback result, or undefined once exhausted; does not close the iterator early.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Iterates a Set, or a Map as (value, key) pairs
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: With the map flag it walks entries and calls fn(value, key); otherwise it delegates to the plain set iteration helper. Short-circuits on the first non-undefined callback result.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Map emplace: update existing key or insert a new one
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Reads get/has/set off the receiver, requires at least one of the update/insert callbacks, and either recomputes the value from the current one or computes a fresh insert value. Writes back through set and returns the resulting value.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Factory for trim / trimStart / trimEnd
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Bit 1 strips leading whitespace, bit 2 strips trailing, both give trim. Coerces the receiver to string and throws on null/undefined.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Number() polyfill handling binary/octal/legacy strings
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Converts via ToPrimitive, throws on Symbols, trims whitespace, and parses 0b/0o prefixes with strict digit validation (returning NaN on bad digits or 0x-after-sign). Called with new, it wraps the result in a Number object whose prototype matches the caller.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Factory for Object.entries / Object.values
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Coerces to object, walks own keys, and skips non-enumerable ones (using `in` when the object has a null prototype). Flag true emits [key, value] pairs, false emits values only.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Defines a getter that records access order in a string
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Each read of property `t` on `e` appends `n` to the closure variable `r` and returns true. Feature-detect helper for whether the engine queries flag getters in spec order.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Throws unless the value is a constructor
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns the argument unchanged when the constructor check passes; otherwise throws TypeError naming the value. Used to validate species/subclass arguments.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: True if a descriptor is a data descriptor
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Checks for an own `value` or `writable` key rather than absence of get/set. Returns false for accessor descriptors and for empty ones.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Lazily attaches the frozen-object fallback store
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Creates the auxiliary entry store on first access and caches it on `.frozen`. Used when a WeakMap key can't carry a hidden id property.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Constructor for the frozen-key fallback store
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Initializes a plain array of [key, value] pairs. Lookup is a linear scan, so it is O(n) and only intended for the rare frozen-key path.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Finds a [key, value] pair in the frozen store
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Linear search over the entries array comparing the key with ===. Returns the pair array or undefined.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: WeakMap/WeakSet set, with frozen-key fallback
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Normal keys get the value stored under the collection's id on the key's hidden metadata object; frozen or sealed keys go into the array-based fallback store. Throws if the key isn't an object and returns the collection.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Wraps fn(this, arg) into a zero-or-one-arg method
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns a function that forwards its receiver plus the first argument, passing undefined when called with none. Keeps the wrapper's declared length at 0.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Gets or creates the nested metadata map for target+key
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Looks up `Eu` (WeakMap of target → WeakMap of property key → metadata map); with `r` truthy it creates missing levels, otherwise returns undefined. Reflect.metadata plumbing; creation mutates the WeakMaps.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Reads metadata, walking up the prototype chain
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: If the metadata key exists as own metadata on target+key it returns the value, else recurses on the prototype via `Qr` (getPrototypeOf). Returns undefined when the chain runs out.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Collects own + inherited metadata keys, deduped
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Merges own keys (`Du`) with the recursive prototype result, deduping through `Fu(Bu(...))`. Own keys come first; returns a new array.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Tests metadata presence including the prototype chain
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Own check via `Gu`, else recurses on the prototype. Boolean only, no value read.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: isRegExp check honoring Symbol.match
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: For objects, `Symbol.match` (`ts`) wins if defined — coerced to boolean — otherwise falls back to the internal class tag being "RegExp". A plain object with `Symbol.match = true` counts as a regexp; a regexp with it set false does not.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Builds a flags string by reading the flag getters
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Asserts `this` is an object, then concatenates d,g,i,m,s,u,v,y in spec order from the boolean properties. Triggers user getters if `this` is a subclass or proxy.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Safe RegExp `flags` read with a fallback
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns `.flags` unless it's undefined on an engine where the accessor is missing/inherited-broken, in which case it recomputes via `rs`. Guards environments where `flags` is not implemented on RegExp.prototype.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Adds a forwarding accessor from one object to another
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: If key `r` is absent from `t`, defines a configurable get/set pair on `t` that reads and writes `e[r]`. No-op when the key already exists anywhere on `t`'s chain.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: RegExp constructor polyfill emulating s, y, and named groups
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Normalizes source/flags (copying flags from a regexp arg), strips unsupported `s`/`y` and rewrites the pattern (`.` → `[\s\S]`), extracts `(?<name>)` groups into an internal groups table, then constructs through `Io` for correct subclassing. Original `source` is restored with a try/catch; malformed or duplicate group names throw SyntaxError.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Patches a String method and its RegExp well-known symbol pair
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Runs feature tests, and if either side is broken (or `r` forces it) installs the pair returned by `e` onto String.prototype and RegExp.prototype via `ie`. The wrapper detects native `exec` to keep the fast path; `n` marks the symbol method with a `sham` flag.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Advances a string index by one code point or one unit
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns `e+1` normally, or `e` plus the length of the code point at that position when `r` (unicode mode) is set. Keeps surrogate pairs from being split during regexp iteration.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Spec-compliant RegExp exec dispatch
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Calls a callable user `exec` and validates the result is null or an object; falls back to native exec when the receiver is a real regexp. Throws TypeError otherwise.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Expands $ patterns in a replacement string
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Handles `$$`, `$&`, `` $` ``, `$'`, `$<name>` (only when named groups `o` exist) and `$n`/`$nn` capture refs, with the two-digit fallback to one-digit when the index overshoots. Unmatched captures expand to empty string; unknown patterns are left literal.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Resolves the @@species constructor with a default
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Reads `constructor` then `Symbol.species` off the object; returns `e` when either is undefined/null, else the value validated as a constructor. Throws if `t` isn't an object or species isn't constructable.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: String.prototype.repeat via exponential doubling
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Coerces `this` to string and count to integer, throwing RangeError on negative or Infinity. O(log n) concatenations instead of n.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Factory producing padStart or padEnd
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: `t` truthy yields padEnd (fill appended), falsy yields padStart. The fill is repeated then truncated to exact width; returns the original string when already long enough or the filler is empty.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Escapes a character as \xNN or \uNNNN
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Takes the code unit at index 0, formats it in hex, zero-padded to 2 digits below 0x100 and 4 digits otherwise. Used by RegExp.escape.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Asserts a real Set, returns it unchanged
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Delegates the internal-slot check to `vf` and passes `t` through, so it can wrap an argument inline. Throws TypeError for Set-likes without the internal slot.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Iterates a set, fast path or iterator-record path
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: With `r` truthy, walks the generic iterator record; otherwise uses the internal fast iteration `mf`. Callback `e` receives each element.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Shallow-copies a set into a new native Set
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Iterates `t` with `Sf` and adds each element to a fresh `Ef` instance. Insertion order preserved.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set Record holder: set, size, has, keys
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Constructor storing the source object plus its normalized non-negative size and its `has`/`keys` methods, each validated as callable. Throws TypeError if either method is missing.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Converts a Set-like to a validated Set Record
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Requires an object, coerces `size` to number — TypeError on NaN/undefined, RangeError on negative — then builds an `If`. The size is read once and trusted afterward.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set.prototype.intersection
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Iterates whichever side is smaller — own elements filtered by `r.includes`, or the other set's iterator filtered by own membership — deleting non-matches from a copy of `this`. Returns a new Set; result order follows `this` in the first branch.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set Record stub representing the empty set
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Reports the given size but `has` always returns false and `keys` yields an immediately-done iterator. Placeholder so set-operation code paths can short-circuit without branching.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Feature-test: does a Set method honor the set-like protocol?
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Calls `new Set()[t]` with a fake set-like of size 0, then one of size -1; correct engines throw on the negative size. Returns true only when the valid call succeeds and the invalid one throws — used to decide whether to polyfill that Set method.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set.prototype.intersection
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Coerces `this` to a Set and `t` to a set record, then iterates whichever side is smaller: the other's iterator when `this` is bigger, otherwise `this` itself. Returns a new Set of shared elements; iteration order follows the side it walked, so it is not always insertion order of `this`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set.prototype.isDisjointFrom
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Walks the smaller collection and returns false on the first common element, closing the foreign iterator via `Tn(n,"normal",false)` when it bails early. Returns true when no element is shared.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set.prototype.isSubsetOf
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Short-circuits false if `this` has more elements than the other set record, then checks every element of `this` is in it. Only calls the other's `has`, never its iterator.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set.prototype.isSupersetOf
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Short-circuits false if `this` is smaller, then drains the other's iterator and returns false at the first element missing from `this`. Closes the iterator on early exit.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set.prototype.symmetricDifference
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Clones `this`, then for each element of the other's iterator removes it if already present and adds it otherwise. Returns the clone; duplicates in the other iterator toggle membership repeatedly, matching spec.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Set.prototype.union
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Clones `this` and adds every element yielded by the other set record's iterator. Returns the clone; original `this` is untouched.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Coerce a value to something with size/has/keys
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns the value unchanged if it already looks set-like (numeric `size`, callable `has` and `keys`); otherwise, if it is iterable or array-like, wraps it in an adapter. Non-iterable non-set-like values pass through untouched, so the caller still has to validate.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: RegExp brand check
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Object whose `Symbol.match` is defined decides the answer by its truthiness; otherwise falls back to the internal class tag. So a plain object with `Symbol.match = false` reports false, and one with a truthy `Symbol.match` reports true.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Expose a well-known symbol on the shim's Symbol namespace
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Adds `Symbol[t]` to the library's Symbol export object if absent, taking the value from the wrapped well-known symbol table. No-op when the key already exists.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Install Symbol.prototype[Symbol.toPrimitive]
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Defines it as a 1-arg method delegating to the original `Symbol.prototype.valueOf`, only when Symbol exists and lacks the method. Ignores the hint argument.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: defineProperty that survives the Object.prototype quirk
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Saves and deletes any same-named own descriptor on `Object.prototype`, defines the property on the target, then restores it. Fallback path for engines that throw when defining on `Object.prototype`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Build a fake Symbol object and register it
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Creates an object inheriting the shim's Symbol prototype, attaches internal state (type, tag, description), and stores it in the all-symbols registry keyed by tag. Sets a plain `description` property when accessors are unavailable.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Object.defineProperty patched for shimmed symbols
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: For a shimmed-symbol key it records enumerability in the target's hidden map and defines the underlying string key as non-enumerable; other keys go straight through. Defining on the Symbol wrapper also mirrors the write onto its prototype.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Object.defineProperties patched for shimmed symbols
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Collects the source's own string keys plus its shimmed symbols and defines each on the target via the patched defineProperty. Skips non-enumerable source props when descriptors are supported.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: propertyIsEnumerable patched for shimmed symbols
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Native result wins except for shimmed symbols, whose visibility comes from the object's hidden enumerability map. On `Object.prototype` itself, registered symbols not explicitly re-declared report false so they stay invisible to `for...in`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: getOwnPropertyDescriptor patched for shimmed symbols
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Returns the raw descriptor but flips `enumerable` back to true for shimmed symbols the object did not mark hidden. Returns undefined for registry keys read off `Object.prototype`.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: getOwnPropertyNames minus shimmed symbol keys
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Filters the native own-key list, dropping keys in the symbol registry and internal hidden keys. Output is string keys only.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Object.getOwnPropertySymbols for shimmed symbols
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Scans own keys, keeps those present in the symbol registry, and maps them back to the wrapper objects. On `Object.prototype` it only reports symbols actually installed there.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: Setter half of a shimmed symbol's accessor property
apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.detail: Writing through the Symbol wrapper mirrors to its prototype, clears the hidden-enumerability flag, and defines the value as a writable non-enumerable prop. If defineProperty throws a TypeError it retries via the Object.prototype-safe path; other errors rethrow.

apps/web/.next/static/chunks/polyfills.j.oneLiner: JSON.stringify wrapper that drops symbol values
